ep9.「――王子君、８周年だと聞きましたよ？」: —Prince, I heard it's the 8th anniversary, is that right?
ep9.「……ふふっ、私の助けがなくとも、\n王子君はきっと、いくつもの戦いを勝ち抜いて: …Hehe, even without my aid, you'd surely have won countless battles and carved out this very future, wouldn't you? ♪
ep9.「お前が立ち止まらなかったからこその、８周年だ」: It's because you didn't stop that we have this 8th anniversary.
ep9.「これからも、\n王子の目指す未来へ、私たちを連れて行ってくださいね」: From now on, please lead us toward the future you envision.
ep9.「そして今も、助けを求める方々のために、\n幾度も剣をとり、戦い続けてくれていま: And even now, you keep taking up your sword time and again for those who call for help.
ep9.「それでは、椅子から立ち上がったことですし、\nこのまま少し、息抜きに出かけまし: Since you've risen from your seat, why don't we take a little break and go out?
ep9.「それでも、王子は戦うことを選んでくれました」: But still, you chose to fight.
ep9.「でも、こんなお祝いの日にまで、\n執務に励んでいるのはどうかと思います」: But I think it's a bit much to be buried in paperwork on a day like this.
ep9.「はい、起立！ 気をつけ！ 空を見よ！」: Alright, stand up! Watch out! Look to the sky!
ep9.「まぁいい。もう少し近くに来い――そうだ」: Fine. Come a little closer… Ah, that's better.
ep9.「まさか、祝ってほしいのか？」: You want me to celebrate, don't you?
ep9.「存分に誇れ」: Take pride in it to your heart's content.
ep9.「星によれば、今日は私とでーとに出かけると、\n良いことがあるそうですからね♪」: According to the stars, going out on a date with me today will bring good fortune, you know? ♪
ep9.「本当は、最初の最初から、\n王子君を助けてあげられたら良かったのですが……」: Honestly, I wish I could've helped you from the very beginning…
ep9.「王子が諦めることなく、常に手を伸ばし続けたからこそ、\n今の王国が、この世界が: Because you never gave up and kept reaching out, I think that's why our kingdom—and this world—exist today.
ep9.「王子の存在は、王国の民にとって、\nかけがえのない誇りです」: Your very presence is an irreplaceable source of pride for the people of the kingdom.
ep9.「王都が陥落したあの日に、\n諦めてしまうことだってできたのに……」: On the day the capital fell, you could have given up…

m110002.―― でーきまーした。\n「統帥の塔」完成ですよー。: ——— It's finally done. The "Tower of Command" is complete!
m110002.――おや、これは予想以上では……？: —Oh my, this is beyond my expectations…?
m110002.――ここが英傑の塔じゃな？\n目の前に見えるのは異界の門かのう。: —Is this the Heroic Tower? The thing ahead looks like a gate to another realm.
m110002.――ふふふ、ようこそ英傑の塔へ。: —Heh heh, welcome to the Heroic Tower.
m110002.――まさかあれは、皇帝陛下！？\nそれに王子殿下の幻まで……！: —No way, that's His Majesty the Emperor!? And even an illusion of the Prince...!
m110002.――戯れが過ぎるのではありませんか？\nソラス様が王子に試練を課したと聞いて来ま: ――Isn't this a bit frivolous? I heard Solais set a trial for the Prince, but now's not the time for a little test of strength…
m110002.――王子君、あなたのご先祖さま、\nそして私達の仲間であった英雄王なんですよ。: —the Prince's ancestors, and the heroic king who was once our comrade.
m110002.――簡単なことです。\n千年戦争の終結から幾星霜。\n私は長い時を、この塔の封印: It's simple. Many ages have passed since the war ended. I've spent a long time sealed within this tower.
m110002.――英傑の塔は、\n２０層が最上階だと思っていましたが……。: —I thought the Heroic Tower's top floor was the 20th level...
m110002.……かつての、敵？\nソラス殿、何故\n白の帝国と王国の関係を知っているのでしょ: ...former enemies? Lord Solais, how do you know about the ties between the White Empire and the Kingdom?
m110002.……これは、過酷ですね。\nまさかこれまでの戦いの情報まで、\nソラス殿に収集さ: ...That's harsh. I never imagined you've gathered all the data from our previous battles, Lord Solais...
m110002.……王子達の力が及ばぬなら、\nここであなたが彼らを蹴散らし、\nこの世界を諦め: …If the Prince's strength can't reach it, you'll drive them away and tell them to abandon this world?
m110002.「統帥結晶」は戦いの記録そのもの。\nこれを使えば、王子ちゃん様の\n神器や武装: A Command Crystal is the battle record itself. Using it, you can enhance your relics and equipment, Your Highness.
m110002.あ、ちょっとうれしそうですね。\nほっぺが緩んでますよ？: Ah, you look a little happy. Your cheeks are all relaxed.
m110002.あの英雄王の力を持ってしても、\nそれでも届かなかった魔王討伐……。: Even with the Hero King's might, we still couldn't bring the Demon King down…
m110002.あらあら、ここで諦めても良いのですよ？: Oh dear, you can give up right here if you like.
m110002.ある種族や職業の方だけ有利に戦えたり、\nその逆もあったりするので、\n次の層に: Some races or jobs will have advantages on certain floors, and the opposite on others—so you'll have to think carefully as you ascend.
m110002.えぇ。英傑の塔は英雄王ちゃん魔術設計、\nソラスちゃん建造の「精鋭を育てる塔」。: Right. The Heroic Tower was designed by the Hero King and built by Solais—a tower to train the elite.
m110002.けれど、ひとまずは休息を。\n戦士には戦うだけでなく、休むことも必要ですからね？: But for now, take a rest. A warrior needs to rest as well as fight, you know?
m110002.けれど、もし『魔王以上の脅威』が迫ったなら……。\nそんな時に備えて、塔が最適な: But if a threat greater than the Demon King ever arises... I've arranged for the tower to self-expand into the optimal form for such a situation.
m110002.さて、それは王子君たちの実力次第♪\nそのための英傑の塔、というわけですからね。: Well, that depends on the Prince's abilities ♪ That's why we have the Heroic Tower, after all.
m110002.さて。ここは王子君を鍛錬するための場所ですから、\n私としても手加減することはで: Now then. This place is meant to train you, Prince, so I won't hold back. If you're going to give up, now's the time, okay?
m110002.そうそう。その光に触れている間は、\n特別な加護を受けることができますよ。\n上: Exactly. While you touch that light, you'll receive a special blessing. Make good use of it.
m110002.それから、王子ちゃんにも良いことがありますよぉ？\n統帥の塔内での戦いは記録され: Also, Prince, there's a perk for you! Battles inside the Tower are recorded and turned into "Command Crystals."
m110002.それから、統帥の塔は訓練施設ですからねぇ。\nより厳しい状況を乗り越えるほど、\: And since it's a training facility, the tougher the conditions you overcome, the higher your score on each floor.
m110002.それじゃあ王子ちゃん、\nさっそく統帥の塔に挑んでみてくださいねぇ♪: So, Prince, go ahead and give the Tower of Command a try! ♪
m110002.それでは、どうぞ、英傑の塔へ――。: Now then, please, proceed to the Heroic Tower—.
m110002.それでは王子君、これまでの戦いの道程と、\n自分と、それに匹敵する好敵手の映し身: Now then, Prince, face the path of your past battles and a mirror image of a worthy opponent equal to you. Defeat it splendidly...!
m110002.それでは２１層の試練を起動しますよ！\n王子君、戦闘準備をお願いします！: Then we'll activate the 21st-floor trial! Prince, prepare for battle!
m110002.ですからまずは、その過程で収集した情報から、\n最初の試練を与えることにしましょ: So, based on the information I've gathered, let's start with the first trial. Your opponent will be—
m110002.でもこれだけでは物足りませんよね……。\nここはひとつ、天使に、デーモンに……。: But that's not enough, is it... Let's throw in an angel, a demon...—that'll do, ♪
m110002.とうすいの、とう……？\n英傑の塔とは違うのか？: Wait, what? Is this different from the Heroic Tower?
m110002.なので、そんな軍の皆さんが、\nはばひろーく訓練できるように、\n各層ごとに色ん: So we've set up different conditions on each floor so everyone can train as broadly as possible.
m110002.なるほど……。\nならば、この塔に入る資格があると認めましょう。: I see… Then I'll acknowledge that you have the right to enter this tower.
m110002.なるほどな……。\nあいつが王子を助けようとしてくれてるってことか。: I see… so he's trying to help the Prince.
m110002.なれば、王子君達に\nその実力の片鱗だけでも見いだせなければ、\nここで諦めるよ: So, unless we can find even a glimpse of your power, Prince, it's our duty as those before you to counsel you to give up here.
m110002.はい♪ お人好しはご先祖様譲りですね、王子君♪: Yes♪ Kindness runs in your ancestors, Prince♪
m110002.はいはい。\n――では統帥の塔の説明をしますねー。: Right, right. Now, let me explain the Tower of Command.
m110002.ひんっ！？\nわざとじゃないんですってばぁ！？: Huh!? I swear I didn't do it on purpose!
m110002.ふふ、やはり。\nあなたなら、かの魔王を\n滅ぼすことがかなうかもしれませんね。: Heh, as I thought. You might actually be able to defeat that Demon King.
m110002.ふふふ、かつての敵からも信頼が厚いとは、\nそういうところもあの人にそっくりです: Heh, even former foes hold you in such high regard—just like that other person.
m110002.ふふふ、さすがに塔が\n自分でそこまで判断はしませんよ♪: Heh, even the tower wouldn't make that kind of judgment on its own♪
m110002.ふふふ。お見事！\nこの階層は制覇されました。: Heh heh. Well done! You've cleared this floor.
m110002.ふむ……。\n塔に入るには相応の実力を見せよ、というわけじゃな。\n王子よ、油断: Hmm… To enter, you must show appropriate strength, that's the idea. Prince, don't let your guard down.
m110002.ふん、上等だ。\nさぁ王子、英雄王にお前の実力を見せてやろうぜ！: Hmph, not bad. Come on, Prince, let's show the Heroic King what you're capable of!
m110002.まぁ、新しい修行の場が増えるのは良いことだけどな。\nそれより、塔なんかに\nお: Well, more training grounds can't be a bad thing. But more than that, I won't stand for the tower saying I'm not strong enough.
m110002.まずは王子君と、王子君が信じる仲間達が、\nこの塔に入るだけの資格があるかどうか: First, Prince, and the comrades you trust, we'll determine whether you're worthy to enter this tower—myself and the tower's guardians will judge.
m110002.よろしい。\n狭間より現れる守護者と、私の魔術。\n見事退け、実力を見せてくださ: Very well. Defeat the guardians that emerge from the limbo and my sorcery. Show us your prowess!
m110002.わぁ……足場が浮いています……！\n魔界とも物質界とも違う、不思議な感じです……: Wow… the ground is floating! It feels strange, unlike either the demon realm or the material world!
m110002.シャディアちゃんは相変わらず心配性ですねぇ。\n何も自分の興味本位で、\nこんな: Shadia-chan, you're as worry-prone as ever. It wasn't built out of my own curiosity, you know?
m110002.ワシらを見くびっては困る。\nこれより過酷な戦場はいくつもあったぞい。: Don't underestimate us. There have been many harsher battlefields than this.
m110002.今の私達では、天界の異変に対抗できないと……。\nそれで突然、２１層に続く階段が: With our current strength, we can't oppose the celestial disturbance… So that's why a staircase to the 21st floor suddenly appeared.
m110002.何とも不思議な術です……。\n……おや？\nソラス殿、あの中央で光輝いているもの: What a strange technique... Hmm? Lord Solais, what's that shining thing in the center?
m110002.具体的には、少人数で突破するほど、\nスコアがよくなる仕組みにしておきました。\: Specifically, the fewer troops you use to clear a floor, the better your score. Once you get the hang of it, try using even smaller squads.
m110002.塔が起動するまで身動きは取れませんでしたが、\nずっと、この世界を見守り続けてい: I couldn't move until the tower reactivated, but I've been watching over this world all along—your two nations' conflict as well.
m110002.対して統帥の塔は……その……えーっとぉ……。\nごにょごにょ……。: In contrast, the Tower of Command is… um… well… you know…
m110002.王国軍は色んな種族、色んな出身、\nそして多種多様な兵科の皆さんがいますからねぇ: After all, the kingdom's forces come from many races, backgrounds, and countless classes.
m110002.異界の門を知っているなんて、\n当代の魔術師も捨てたものではなさそうですね。\n: Knowing about a gate to another world—seems even modern magicians haven't discarded that knowledge. In that it's a liminal space connecting elsewhere, it's similar.
m110002.私は彼の未来を想う願いを再現できるように、\nこの塔を設計したに過ぎませんからね: I only designed this tower so I could recreate the wish to protect his future!
m110002.私もそのつもりでしたよ？\n２０層まで上り詰めれば、魔王ガリウスに\n対抗できる: I thought the same. I believed that reaching the 20th floor would grant us the power to stand against Demon King Garius.
m110002.私達も、あの魔王を真に滅ぼすことは出来ませんでした。\nただアイギス様のお力を借: We couldn't truly vanquish that Demon King ourselves. All we did was borrow Aegis's power to seal him temporarily, pushing the problem into the future.
m110002.統帥の塔は、アンブローズ様がど忘れして、\n私ごと、ざっと千年放置した\n王国大: The Tower of Command is something Ambrose forgot about, and I left it alone for a thousand years, inheriting the philosophy of the Great Kingdom Labyrinth.
m110002.統帥の塔は、様々な状況下で訓練を積む装置、\nというかつての迷宮の思想を反映した: The Tower of Command is a training device for various situations—a facility that reflects the old labyrinth's ideas and strengthens the entire army.
m110002.英傑の塔の意思というべきもの。\n次代の英雄にあらゆる智慧と武技を授けんと、\n: You could call it the will of the Heroic Tower. It wove a management magic to grant the next generation of heroes all the wisdom and martial skill they need, to spur their growth—
m110002.諦めるなど……。\n我ら帝国が実力を認めた王子は、\nこんな所で引き返すような器: Give up…? The Prince whom our Empire has recognized for his strength is not one to turn back here.
m110002.魔法都市に似ているような気もしますけど、\n見たことのない構造物ばかりです……。: It reminds me of a magical city, but everything here is a structure I've never seen…

m300100.――えッ！？\nな、何よ……あれ？\nデーモンが合体している……？: —What!? Wh-what's that... huh? The demons are merging...?
m300100.――レオナさん！？\n私たちもすぐに加勢します！:
--Leona!
We'll rush to aid you right away!
m300100.――報告！\n左舷後方よりキマイラの襲撃を確認！: —Report! We've confirmed a chimera attack from the rear left side!
m300100.……いやまてよ。\nこの騎獣の破壊力ならば、人間など粉々ダ。\n多少の傷ならばク: …Wait a minute. With the destructive power of this riding beast, humans would be pulverized. A few scratches wouldn't even be noticeable to the Queen.
m300100.……くそッ！\n辺境の村の魔物退治と甘く見ていたが、\nまさか我が軍がここまで押:
...Dammit!
I thought clearing monsters from the frontier villages would be easy, but I never imagined our forces would be pushed back this far...
m300100.……でも、操られでもしないと、\nオレにあんなヒドイことなんてしないしなぁ……。:
…But if they aren't being controlled,
they wouldn't do something so horrible to me.
Could it be they're really being controlled…?
m300100.……人間に与したラクシャーサ様に、委細を話す\n義理はありません。邪魔立てするな:
...I have no obligation to explain the details to you, Rakshasa who has given himself to humans.
If you interfere, even you will be destroyed...!
m300100.……何とか、勝てたか。\n今回の助力、不本意ではあったが、\n感謝しておく……王:
...We somehow managed to win.
Your assistance was reluctant, but I appreciate it... Prince.
m300100.ああむしゃくしゃするなぁッ！\nお前ら、このボリス様をなめるなよ！\n全速前進で: Ugh, this is infuriating! You all, don't underestimate me, Boris! Full speed ahead into the Imperial Capital!
m300100.ああッ！？\nファーさん、お猿さん達が逃げていきます！:
Huh!?
Far-san, the monkeys are running away!
m300100.あなた誰？ 素人の助けなんて無い方がマシよ。\n言っておくけど、デーモンを倒した:
Who are you? You'd be better off without a rookie's help.
Just so you know, I've taken down more demons than you have.
m300100.あの……お怪我はありませんか？: Um... are you hurt at all?
m300100.あのゴーレムは、一度でも攻撃を受けると\n敵を排除する為に敵対してきます。: If that golem takes even a single hit, it will turn hostile to eliminate the enemy.
m300100.あまり急がれては危ないですよ？\nこの区域には巡回用のクリスタルゴーレムが\n多: Rushing too much could be dangerous. This area is packed with patrol crystal golems.
m300100.いいってことよ！\nさってと、久しぶりに暴れてみるかねぇ……。: It's fine! Come on, let's go tear it up again after a while.
m300100.いや、ボリス殿……？\n帝都に突っ込むのは如何なものかと……。: Um, Lord Boris…? Rushing into the capital like that—are you sure that's wise?
m300100.うーん、まぁそんなとこね。\nにしても、さっきの合体したデーモンには、\nあなた: Hmm, something like that. Anyway, you should be careful with that fused demon we just saw.
m300100.えぇ～……。\nという事は、魔法を使っちゃいけないのか……。\n魔法都市の防犯装: Gee… so we can't use magic? It's a security system for the magical city, huh. Makes sense.
m300100.えーっと……。\n「……であるからして、……原理の追究には」\n……あぁ～……難: Um… “...because… the pursuit of the principle…” …ah… difficult…
m300100.おい、王子！\nあんたもボサっと見てねぇで手伝ってくれよ！:
Hey, Prince!
Stop just standing there and help me out!
m300100.おい、私の芸術作品に汚い手で触るナ！\nゴブリンクイーン様ヘ、お披露目する迄に、: Hey, don't dirty my masterpiece! Before I present it to Goblin Queen, there's still plenty of tweaking to do!
m300100.おいおいおいッ！？\n何も逃げ出すことねぇだろ……なんでだよぉ……。:
Hey hey hey—!?
There's no reason to run away… why is this happening…?
m300100.おい！ そこのお嬢ちゃん、早くこっちへ来いよ！\nデーモンにやられちまうぜ！:
Hey! You there, girl, come over here quickly!
You'll get crushed by demons otherwise!
m300100.おお……この体……素晴らしい……ッ！\nこの合体を繰り返せば他のデーモン達の\n: Ah... this body... magnificent...! If I keep merging like this, I can absorb all the power of the other demons...
m300100.おおッ！？\nあの出で立ち、間違いのう酒呑童子の手下だ！\nいっちょオイがくらし: Oh!? That garb—it's a henchman of the drunken oni! I'll take him down! Prepare yourself!
m300100.お前、私のこと\nそんな風に思ってたのか……？: You… thought of me that way…?
m300100.お酒……ですか。\n祝い酒で済めばいいのですが……。: Alcohol… huh. I hope it's just celebratory sake…
m300100.お～い、王子、アンナぁ！！\n駄弁ってないで早く帰ろうぜー？\n今夜の酒宴は王子: Hey, Prince, Anna!! Stop dawdling and let's get going—tonight's banquet, you're one of the stars too.
m300100.かたッ苦しいことは言いっこなしだぜドワイト！\nそれに見てみろ！\n陛下も異論は: I've got no qualms about it, Dwight! And look—Your Highness doesn't seem to object, either.
m300100.く……ぬぁぁあああ……あ…。\nさ、再生が及ばぬ……。\n一度魔界に戻らねば……:
Ku... nuaa... ah...
I can't regenerate...
I must return to the demon realm...
m300100.くそ、魔物め……ッ！？\n総員、直ちに臨戦態勢を取れ！: Damn those monsters…! Everyone, get into combat stance immediately!
m300100.くっそぉー、もう怒ったぞ！\nここはもう一回、誰がボスかをしっかりと\n分からせ:
Damn it—I'm angry now!
I'll make it crystal clear who's the boss here, once again!
m300100.ぐうぅッーー！？\n何だ、この強ぇ風は……\nこれじゃ近寄ることもできん……。: Guh—! What's with this fierce wind… I can't even get close!
m300100.こ、このくらいの揺れで、\n慌てるんじゃねえ！: Don't lose your head over a little tremor!
m300100.このくらいの傷ならもう一戦くらい\n魔物とやり合うことだって――どぅわッ！？\n: With damage like this we could still take on another monster fight— what the—! What's causing this shaking?
m300100.これはまだ未完成品ダ……。\nクイーン様用の輿もまだ出来ていないし、\nクイーン: This is still unfinished… I haven't even finished the carriage for the Queen yet, and unless she rides it, its true power…
m300100.こんな狭い洞窟で戦車！？\n王子、慎重なご采配をお願い致します！: A tank in this cramped cave? Prince, please command us cautiously!
m300100.さぁお前ら出てこいーー！\n俺様が帰ってきたぞーーー！:
Come on, you all step forward—!
I'm back—!
m300100.さあ、全軍撤収だ！\n急ぎ帝国へ戻り、\n陛下への報告を一刻も早く行うぞ！:
Alright, withdraw all troops!
Hurry back to the Empire and report to His Majesty immediately!

stay close—wait, Prince, stop!

m300204.どうやら、毒蛇と戦っているようですね。: It seems they're battling the poisonous snake.

Seems they're pretty riled up.
They get even more ferocious during a full moon, so stay on guard.
m300204.なるほど、その為に予告状を……。: I see, so that's why the warning…

For now, let's keep watch while we continue the survey.
We can't rule out more Myconids appearing.
m300204.ふぅ、何とか片付いたね。: Phew, we managed to clear them out.

m300204.ふふっ、そうですわね。\n凱旋のようで、祖国のことを思い出しますわ。: Hehe, indeed. It feels like a triumphant return, reminds me of my homeland.
m300204.ふむ……ルチアの頼みでもあるし、\nしばらくは付き合ってやるか……。: Hmm… It's Lucia's request too, so I guess I'll stick around for a while…

m300204.もうこの世界樹が、\nひとつの街みたいなものですね……。: So this World Tree is basically a whole town…

m300204.やっぱりさぁ、ドリーには止められたけど、\n自爆装置とかつけるべきだったかなぁ？: Still, yeah, Dolly stopped me, but maybe we should've added a self-destruct device?

m300204.オーク達、ボロボロなのに何だか嬉しそうだな。: The Orcs look battered, yet somehow happy.

m300204.スーシェンに味は分りかねますが――\nお祭り、賑やかな屋台、皆の笑顔……。\n何: I can't really tell the taste, but— the festival, the bustling stalls, everyone's smiles… for some reason, it feels nostalgic. *nom*
m300204.ドリーさんたち工兵の方々や、\nくぐつ師の方々のおかげです。\n本当にありがとう: It's thanks to you engineers and the shipwrights. Thank you so much.
m300204.一応、雪国出身だからね。\n自然に宿るエネルギーが異常に集まると、\nあんな風に: Well, I'm from the snowy lands, so yeah. When natural energy gathers abnormally, it can manifest like that.
m300204.人気闘兵には城下の民の力も借りたでしょう？\nだから結果のお披露目も、\n盛大に: They borrowed the townsfolk's strength for the popular troops, right? So they asked for a grand presentation as well.

Prince, please prepare for battle!

m300204.王子、毒蛇は毒を飛ばしてくるぞ。\n当たったらその周囲にも毒がばら撒かれるんだ。: Prince, the snake spits poison. If it hits, the surrounding area gets drenched in toxin.

Let's pause the moon-viewing and deal with the wolves.
m300204.王子。クルルさんの助言通り、\nここは迅速かつ慎重に事を運びましょう！: Prince, as Krul suggested, let's handle this swiftly and carefully!

m300204.私たちは王子と共に、魔物などの脅威から、\n人々を守るために戦っている者です。: We fight alongside the Prince to protect people from monsters and other threats.
m300204.腕を磨くためと毒蛇退治に来てみたが、\nやはり蛇や獣の類よりも、\n腕の立つ戦士: I came to sharpen my arms and hunt the poisonous snake, but fighting skilled warriors is even better than beasts…

m400348.場所は、地下洞窟……。: The location is the underground caves….

Prince…
We've fought them many times, but please don't let your guard down.

It's no wonder you're famed for your good nature, Prince!
It gives me confidence. I'll guide you to the base.
m400418.かつての千年戦争で、魔物の軍勢として戦ったと\n言われる「竜人」と呼ばれる種族を: Are you familiar with the race called “Draconians,” who are said to have fought as monsters' troops in the ancient Millennium War?

Along the invasion route of the revived draconians lie many settlements populated by people.

m400418.なので、『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、\nワルキューレを出撃メンバーにいれたほ: So it might be wise to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your deployment team.

It is also said that draconians who live long gain great intelligence.

We've established a base at the entrance of the cave where the draconians were sealed.
Prince, for the sake of the villagers, could you halt the draconians led by the Black Elder at that base?

m400418.私の名はエレニア。\n王子、あなたのご武勇を聞き参りました。:
My name is Erenia.
Prince, I've come to hear of your valor.

That's good… You're willing to fight.
As expected of a kind-hearted prince… *cough cough*

m400509.そいつはよくないなぁ……。\n海であれ森であれ、\n漁場の所有権は王子クンにある: That's not good… Whether it's the sea or the forest, the fishing rights belong to you, Prince.

m400509.ゴブリンにはそういう文化がない可能性もある。\n正式に抗議して、それで聞いてくれ: Goblins might just not have that kind of culture. If a formal protest doesn't work, maybe we should give them a good blast?
m400509.ゴブリン軍団は物質界連合の一員ではありますが、\n未だ、解散後には敵対すると公言: Goblins are part of the Material Realm Alliance, but they've openly declared that they'll turn hostile after the dissolution—so they're a potential enemy force.
m400509.メカゴブリンクイーンの配下を騙る、\n別勢力のゴブリンである可能性もあります。: There's a chance these are goblins from another faction posing as Mecha-Goblin Queen's subordinates.
m400509.戦闘になっても、現場は私たちの縄張りだ。\n船団で囲んで、負傷者はしっかり回収す: Even once combat starts, this is still our territory. We'll encircle them with our fleet and make sure any wounded are properly rescued.
m400509.海上演習を王国領内でするつもりなら、\n正式に届け出をしろと伝えてみたが、\nこ: I told them that if they plan to conduct naval exercises within kingdom waters, they need to file an official report, but they keep insisting they're just anchored.
m400509.軍事行動と略奪を一緒にするな、まったく。\n――よし、それじゃあ各員出撃の準備を:
Don't mix combat with looting, honestly.
—Alright then, everyone, prepare to deploy.
The "Grand Subjugation Mission" begins!

m400582.――そろそろ、ハロウィンの祝祭が始まりますね。: ――It's about time the Halloween festivities begin.
m400582.――大変です王子！\n突如としてチェーンソーを振り回す怪物たちが現れ、\n仮装を:
――Prince, this is bad!
Monsters wielding chainsaws have suddenly appeared,
and they're rampaging through the venue along with the costumed villagers!!
m400582.――賑やかな声が聞こえると思ったら、\nもうハロウィンが始まっていたのかしら？:
I heard all that commotion and thought
the Halloween party had already started, hadn't it?
m400582.……まぁ、賑やかでいいと思いましょうか。: ……Well, I suppose the noise is good for the atmosphere.
m400582.……もしかしてだけど、\nさっきのは模擬戦ではなかったの……？:
...Wait, but,
was that not a sparring match just now...?
m400582.『大討伐ミッション』は、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒す事が目的です。:
The objective of a "Grand Cull Mission" is
to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400582.あ、ありがとうございますウィリアスさ……\nあんた洗脳されてるだろ！！:
Oh, thank you, Willias...!
You're brainwashed, aren't you?!
m400582.ああもう！ こうなりゃヤケだ！\nやるだけやってやんよぉぉぉ！！:
Ugh, fine! I'm done holding back!
I'm going to give it everything I've got!!
m400582.あっ、飾りといえばね、\n実はレミィとクーコも会場の準備を手伝ってくれたの！:
Oh, and speaking of decorations,
Remi and Kouko actually helped with the venue preparations too!
m400582.あの様子は精神支配されていますわ！\n村人たちが被っている仮面には、\n着けた者:
They appear to be under mental domination!
The masks the villagers are wearing
seem to have an effect that drives the wearer into a frenzy!
m400582.あれは……レミィさんとクーコさん！\n助かりました！ かの雷神の娘と風神の娘であ:
That's... Remii and Kuuko!
We're saved! With the daughter of the Thunder God and the daughter of the Wind God here, we've got the strength of a hundred men!
m400582.いいやまだよコレット！\nあっちがふたりなら、こっちもふたりでかかればいいわ！:
No, it's not, Colette!
If there are two of them over there, we'll just have two of us go at them!
m400582.いくぜェ！ ゴーストゾンビシャーク！！: Here I come! Ghost Zombie Shark!!
m400582.いけません！ チェインソン男が、\nハロウィンの力に飲まれ爆転しています！:
This is bad! Chainson Man is being
swallowed by the power of Halloween and transforming!
m400582.う、ぐっ、ぐぉぉぉーー！！\nチェーンソーが、暴れ回って……！？\nまずいっ、ハ:
Ugh... Grr... GAAAAH!!
The chainsaw is... going haywire...!?
This is bad! I'm being consumed by Halloween!
m400582.うぅ……俺たちは……いったい……？: Ugh... what... has happened... to us...?
m400582.うわっ、ふざけた言動に反して普通に強そうなのが\n腹立ちますね……！\nこれはち:
Ugh, it's infuriating that he looks
strong despite his ridiculous behavior...!
This might be tough...!
m400582.うん！ 任せてよチェインソン男くん！ （裏声）: Yes! Leave it to me, Chainson Man! (High-pitched voice)
m400582.え……。\n会場を直して、ハロウィンを楽しもう、ですか？:
Ehh...
Fix the venue and enjoy Halloween, is it?
m400582.ええっ！ じゃあ私たち、\n悪いことしちゃったんじゃ……！:
Ehh! Then we...
we did something bad, didn't we...!
m400582.お咎めなし、ですか。\nまったく、王子殿下は……。:
No punishment, is it.
Honestly, Your Highness...
m400582.これは、暴走……！？\n肉体が変形して、デーモンみたいになっていくわ！:
It's a rampage...!?
His body is mutating! He's turning into a demon!
m400582.させないぜッ！ 喰らえ！！\nデスハロウィン洗脳ビームッ！！:
I won't let you! Take this!!
Death Halloween Brainwashing Beam!!
m400582.すでに乱闘が起こって……。\nなんでただの村人の方も殺気立っているんですか！？:
A brawl has already broken out...
Why are the regular villagers getting so aggressive too?!
m400582.そういうことなら私もやるわ！\n折角作った飾りが壊れたままっていうのも悲しいもの:
If that's the case, I'll help too!
It's sad to leave the decorations we worked so hard on all broken!
m400582.そういえば、ちらっと見ましたけど、\nカボチャの飾りとか可愛くできてましたね。:
Speaking of which, I caught a glimpse earlier.
The pumpkin decorations you made were adorable.
m400582.そうは問屋とチェーンソーが卸さねェェ！\nギュイィィィィン！！\n俺たちの刃が回:
??? : Not so fast, you and your chainsaws!
Gyeeeeeein!!
Our blades are spinning up to full speed!!
m400582.だったら俺たちにも手伝わせてくれ！\nキエェェー！ 詫びハロウィン準備だァーー！:
Then let us help too!
Kieeeeee! It's time to prepare for the Apology Halloween!!
m400582.だったら話は簡単ね！\nみんなまとめて倒して、それから保護するわよ！:
Then the solution is simple!
We take them all down, and then we protect the survivors!
m400582.でしたら、今から見に行きましょうか。\nちょうどハロウィンが始まる時間です。\n:
Then, let's go take a look.
It's just about time for Halloween to start.
Look, beyond the window, the villagers are enjoying the festivities……
m400582.では王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Now then, Prince, I shall issue the order for the "Grand Cull Mission"!
m400582.とはいえ、ハロウィン会場には人が大勢集まっており、\n普段のような部隊展開を行う:
That said, since a large crowd has gathered at the Halloween venue,
it will be difficult to deploy units as usual.
m400582.な、なんですかコイツら！？\nチェーンソーを持った怪物たちが、\n会場を練り歩い:
W-what are those things?!
Monsters wielding chainsaws are
wandering through the venue...!?
m400582.なにが起こるか分からない状況のため、\nこちらも万全の準備をして臨みましょう。:
Given the unpredictable situation,
we must prepare thoroughly before we proceed.
m400582.なんか変なのいませんでした？？？: Wasn't there something weird going on just now???
m400582.なんにせよ、この騒動をどうにかしないと、\nハロウィンを楽しめないわよ！\nさっ:
Regardless, we have to deal with this commotion,
or we won't be able to enjoy Halloween!
Let's go, Prince!
m400582.ふふっ。ハロウィンに相応しい、楽しい催しじゃない。\nそれなら王子くんたちと手合:
Fufu. A fun event that's perfectly suited for Halloween.
In that case, let's have a little match with the Prince and his friends♪
m400582.ほ、本当！？ 何回も練習し――こほんっ！\n私は手先だって器用なんだから、あれく:
R-Really?! I practiced so many times, but― cough!
I'm quite dexterous with my hands, you know. That was a piece of cake for me!
m400582.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを\n入手出来ない点にも気を付けて下さい。:
Also, please be aware that you will not gain any EXP or Gold
from defeating enemies.
m400582.みんな仮装して楽しそうじゃない！\n私たち、一歩遅れちゃったわね！:
Everyone is costumed up and having so much fun!
We must have arrived just a little too late!
m400582.もうすっごいんだから！\n王子にも今すぐ見てもらいたいくらい！:
They did an amazing job!
I want the Prince to see them right now!
m400582.もちろん私も手伝うわよ。\nお姉ちゃんに任せてね。:
Of course, I'll help too.
Leave it to your big sister.
m400582.よしっ！ これで少しは静かに……。: Good! Now things will be a bit quieter...
m400582.んん？ 王子たちがいるってことは……分かったわ！\nこれはきっと模擬戦ね！:
Hm? If the Prince is here, then... I get it!
This must be a sparring match!
m400582.アンデッドたちが襲ってきます……！？\nちくしょう！ とんだハロウィンですよ！！:
The undead are attacking…!?
Damn it! What a Halloween this is turning out to be!!
--- scene: Divine Rank (battle, end) ---
m400582.ウッヒョーッ！ 暴走したぜッ！！\n腕も４本に増えてチェーンソーもご機嫌だッ！:
WHEEE! I'm going wild!!
I've got four arms now, and the chainsaws are in a great mood!
m400582.キエェェ―！ トリック・オア・ローキック！\nトリック・オア・ローキック！\n執:
Halloween Brainwashed Villager B: Kyeee—! Trick or treat, low kick!
Trick or treat, low kick!
I'm going to keep hammering those knees!
m400582.ケヒャァー！！\nトリック・オア・疾風の翼！\nトリック・オア・疾風の翼ァ！:
Kyahh!!
Trick or Treat, Wings of the Gale!
Trick or Treat, Wings of the Gale!
m400582.チェインソン男が倒れたことで、\n皆さんの精神支配も解けたようですわね。:
Now that Chainson Man has been defeated,
it seems everyone's minds have been freed from his control.
m400582.チェインソン男だかなんだか知らないけど、\nよくも祝祭をめちゃくちゃにしてくれた:
I don't care what you call yourselves,
but you really shouldn't have wrecked the festival!
We all worked so hard to prepare for it!
m400582.チェーンソッソッソォ！！\nいや……それに関しては本当にごめんって……。\n暴動:
Chainso-so-so—!
Ah... I'm really sorry about that...
Once the riot is over, I'll help you fix everything...
m400582.ハロウィン会場からの報告によると、\nチェーンソーを振り回している怪物だけでなく:
Reports from the Halloween venue indicate that, in addition to the monsters
wielding chainsaws, there are also costumed villagers and the undead
gathering there.
m400582.ヒャッハー！ トリック・オア・右フック！\nトリック・オア・右フックゥ！\nどう:
Halloween Brainwashed Villager A: Hyah-hah! Trick or treat, right hook!
Trick or treat, right hook!
How's that? Your body's taking some real damage, isn't it!
m400582.ビジュアルもカッコよくなっちまったなァ！\nこれで次の人気闘兵１位は俺のモンだぜ:
My look is way cooler now, too!
I'm definitely going to be the top popular fighter next time!
m400582.一緒にハロウィンの仮装をしたから分かるわ！\nあなたなら絶対に大丈夫よ！:
I know because we dressed up for Halloween together!
You'll be absolutely fine!
m400582.今日に向けて衣裳も用意して、\n村の人たちと会場の飾りつけも頑張ったわ。\nきっ:
I prepared the costumes for today, and I really worked hard on decorating the venue with the villagers.
I'm sure it's going to be a wonderful Halloween♪
m400582.今日のアンナさんは何を言っているんですか！？: What are you talking about, Anna?!
m400582.俺たちはハロウィンでパワーアップしたアンデッド！\nチェインソン男とでも呼んでく:
We are the undead, powered up by Halloween!
Call us the Chainson Men, if you like!
Sorry, but this festival is going to be a festival of violence!!
m400582.俺たちもやるぜ！\n村人の力を見せてやらァーー！！:
We're in too!
Let's show you the strength of the villagers!!
m400582.出撃されるのですね、王子。\nですがその前に、今回のミッションは、\n敵の討伐を:
Very well, Prince. You are deploying.
However, before that, please note that this operation is a
"Grand Cull Mission," aimed at eliminating the enemies.
m400582.出撃コストが時間経過では回復しないため、\nスキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、:
Because deployment cost does not recover over time,
I recommend including members with the "Reinforcement Request" skill,
or Valkyries, in your formation.
m400582.名案じゃない！ お詫びもかねて、全力で頑張るわ！: That's a great idea! As an apology, I'll give it my all!
m400582.嘘でしょ……きゃぁーー！？\n頑張って作った飾りつけが破壊されてるじゃない！？:
No way…… Aaaah!?
They're destroying the decorations I worked so hard on!?
m400582.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、:
Even if the base's life reaches zero,
the number of enemies defeated up to that point will be recorded,
so do not fear falling; stand against the enemy.
m400582.王子殿下、大変なハロウィンでしたから、\nあとでいっぱい、埋め合わせをしてくださ:
Your Highness, it was quite a chaotic Halloween.
I'll make it up to you later, so just wait.
m400582.現状は……バリケードを設置して凌いでいるようですね。\nですが外側に仮装した村人:
It seems they are currently holding their ground behind barricades.
However, there are costumed villagers on the outside,
making it impossible to distinguish them from the undead.
m400582.痛っ！ やめ……上等だァァーー！！\nそんなにハロウィンしたいならお菓子をくれて:
Ow! Stop... Fine, I'm done holding back!!
If you want Halloween so badly, I'll give you some candy!
But it's gonna taste like your blood, you hear me!!
m400582.窓から見える範囲で、暴れているのは……。\n怪物の仮面を被っている村人……！？\:
From what I can see out the window, the ones rampaging are……
Villagers wearing monster masks……!?
What on earth is happening…….
m400582.細かいことはいいじゃない！\nみんなでハロウィンを楽しみましょう！:
Who cares about the details!
Let's all enjoy Halloween!
m400582.通りすがりのシャルロットさん！！: Charlotte, who just happened to be passing by!!
m400582.闇夜の時間が近づいているおかげで、\nアンデッドたちの動きも活発になってるぜ！\:
Now that night is falling,
the undead are getting more active!
Let's go, everyone! It's Halloween time!

m500401.――さて、報告は以上だけど、\n王子にはもうひとつ仕事が残っているぞ。:
――Well, that concludes the report, but
you have one more task to do, Prince.
m500401.――失礼します。\n魔界戦線のご報告です。:
――Pardon the intrusion.
I have a report on the situation at the Demon Realm front.
m500401.――止めるのが一歩遅かったな。\n王子は乗り気みたいだぞ？:
――Too late to stop him.
It looks like the Prince is up for it?
m500401.――王子、来てくれたか。\nだが戦況は最悪だ。\n魔神の侵攻を遅らせることすらで:
――Prince, you came.
But the situation is dire.
We can't even slow the Demon Gods' advance.
m500401.――王子、気をつけろ！\n魔神アモンの魔力が増幅しているぞ！:
――Prince, be careful!
The Demon God Amon's magic power is amplifying!
m500401.……ただ、暴走の原因は不明なままです。\n今後も調査が必要ですね。:
……However, the cause of the berserk state remains unknown.
Further investigation will be necessary.
m500401.……はぁ、分かってないって顔だね。\nあの強力な魔神を、同時に２体も討伐したんだ:
……Sigh, you look like you don't get it.
You defeated two powerful Demon Gods at the same time, you know?
m500401.……はぁ。\n王子、くれぐれも身体を壊さない程度でお願いしますね？:
……Sigh.
Prince, please be careful not to overdo it and make yourself sick, okay?
m500401.……やれやれ、今度こそ決着か？: ……Well, well. Is this finally the end?
m500401.……答えを聞くまでもなさそう、ですね。\n魔界には私たちの仲間も大勢います。\n:
……I don't think we need to ask for your answer.
We have many comrades in the Demon Realm as well.
We must stop the Demon Gods' assault!
m500401.あ、あの……王子は遠征から戻った直後で、\nそれに魔界でも飲み明かしてきたばかり:
Ah, um…… the Prince has just returned from the expedition,
and he also just finished drinking all night in the Demon Realm――
m500401.ああ。王子、危険な作戦になるとは承知している。\nだがどうか、力を貸してほしい。:
Yes. Prince, I know this will be a dangerous operation.
But please, lend us your strength.
m500401.ああ。魔神ほどの強靭な器が、\n吹き飛ぶほどの魔力が貯蔵されたなら、\n魔界など:
Yes. If a vessel as sturdy as a Demon God
were to store enough magic power to blow itself apart,
the resulting force would be enough to obliterate the Demon Realm.
m500401.あの後、キメリエス、アモン共に、\n復活する様子はまったく見られない。:
After that, there were no signs whatsoever
of either Kimeres or Amon reviving.
m500401.うぅぅ～……。\nいやーな感じ……ぎりぎり爆発してないっていうか、\nもういつ弾:
Uuuu……
It feels awful…… like it's on the verge of exploding,
and it could blow apart at any moment……
m500401.このまま無尽蔵に魔力を溜め込めば、\nいずれ、遠くないタイミングで……。:
If they keep hoarding magic power without limit,
before long, at some point soon……
m500401.これなるは神に至る試練を超越せしもの。: This is the transcendence of the trial that leads to godhood.
m500401.これは……！\nアモンが周囲に展開していた、\n生命力を削る力が戦場全域に広がっ:
This is……!
The power Amon was projecting around him,
which drains life force, is spreading across the entire battlefield!
m500401.これまでと同じ、とは思わないほうがいいな。\nこの異常な魔力量だ、己の消滅を厭わ:
I wouldn't count on this being the same as before.
With that abnormal amount of magic power, they might unleash a force that doesn't even care about their own annihilation.
m500401.せっかく魔界に来たんだ。\nついでに戦った者たちをねぎらってやってくれないか？:
Since we've come all the way to the Demon Realm,
wouldn't you like to take a moment to commend those who fought?
m500401.そしてそれが２体同時。\n……被害予想は、不可能ですね。:
And that would happen to two of them at once.
……Estimating the damage is impossible.
m500401.その魔神に対して、人類が一矢報いたのです。\n誰もがあなたの言葉を聞きたがってい:
Humanity has struck back against them.
Everyone wants to hear what you have to say.
m500401.それすら超えて見せるか、我が愛しき英雄よ。: Will you surpass even that, my beloved hero?
m500401.それでも魔力を溜め込むのをやめない、のかぁ\nこれはもう、彼らの意志とは関係ない:
And yet, they still refuse to stop hoarding magic power……
I'd say this has nothing to do with their will anymore.
It looks like a complete runaway situation.
m500401.それに、魔術師の話じゃ\nもっと酷いことになる可能性もあるんだろう？:
Besides, the mages say
there's a possibility things could get even worse, isn't there?
m500401.そんな……。\nす、すぐに助けにいかないと！:
No……
W-we have to go help them right away!
m500401.でも魔神本体も平気ではいられないみたいね。\n見て、臨界に近づいた魔力のせいで、:
But the Demon Gods themselves don't seem to be doing well either.
Look, due to the magic power nearing its critical point,
their bodies are starting to gradually collapse.
m500401.ともあれ、此度の魔神同時討伐、お疲れ様でした！:
In any case, well done on the simultaneous defeat of the Demon Gods!
--- scene: Ultra Extreme (battle, route) ---
m500401.なぜ僕が――はぁ……。\nまぁいい、ほら行くぞ王子。\n今回の主役はお前なんだか:
Why do I have to――Haa…….
Fine, come on, Prince.
You're the star of the show this time, after all!
m500401.なんだ……？\nキメリエスの眷属の士気が上がったぞ。:
What is this……?
The morale of Kimeres's subordinates has risen.
m500401.ね、ねぇ、ベルーフェちゃん？\nこの魔力の響き方、やばやばじゃない……！？:
H-Hey, Belphe?
The way this magic power is resonating…… this is bad, isn't it……!?
m500401.ふふふ、でも勝利は勝利ですよ！\nはぁ、本当に大変な戦いでしたぁ……。:
Hehehe, but a victory is a victory!
Haa, what a truly grueling battle it was……
m500401.もしかして、ば、爆発しちゃったりする……？: Could it, um, end up exploding……?
m500401.よし、そうと決まれば酒宴の準備だな。\nヘンゼル、お前も手伝ってくれ。:
Good. If that's settled, we need to prepare for a feast.
Hansel, you help out too.
m500401.アモンの灼熱の力が『暴走』している！\n戦場すべてが、灼熱の炎で満たされていくぞ:
Amon's scorching power is "running wild"!
The entire battlefield is being filled with blazing flames!
m500401.キメリエスとアモンは、\nこの後どうなるのでしょうか……。: What will happen to Chimeraes and Amon now……?
m500401.ダークエルフ、オークたちが連携して\nどうにか侵攻速度を抑えてはいるが\n魔神相:
The Dark Elves and Orcs are coordinating to slow the advance,
but against Demon Gods, their efforts are nearly meaningless.

Had we been a step behind,

Barrier system linked units are operating normally.

Ah, um, there's something I'm curious about,

That's right. An abnormally massive mechanical structure was discovered
on the regular shipping route to the Steel Capital.
m500510.あとは……仮でも良いので、\n巨大機械に何か名称を――:
And then…… even if it's just a placeholder,

Those tentacle-like things!
So we just need to destroy them, right?

W-Wha, wait!

The local fishermen
have barged in here carrying fish!

It's likely the source of Demigorgos's abnormal durability.

This might just be

Demorgos!

Don't let your guard down!

Whoa—!

Mm-hm, good attitude.
—Well then, let's begin our preparations.
