This battle will determine how much influence
the county will hold in the empire going forward.
m500527.さぁ帝国軍よ！\n湯水のように金を注ぎ込んだこの最強兵器！\nその威力、身を持っ:
Now then, Imperial Army!
Behold this ultimate weapon, into which we poured gold like water!
Feel its power with your own bodies!!
m500527.さすれば、帝国が強くなるほど伯爵領の名も上がり、\nなおかつ皇帝はお前を無視でき:
That way, the stronger the empire becomes, the higher the county's name rises.
And the Emperor will no longer be able to ignore you.
m500527.さて、演習が終わったのなら、\n双方の兵のために、慰労が必要ですわね。:
Now that the exercise is over,
we must hold a celebration for the soldiers on both sides.
m500527.しかぁし！\nベラート要塞が最強たる所以はここにあり！:
But!
The reason Belart Fortress is the strongest is right here!
m500527.その交易によって得た有り余る財を、\nこうした防衛設備に注ぎ込んでいたのでしょう:
He likely poured the surplus wealth from that trade
into defensive infrastructure like this.
m500527.その意気やよし！\nさぁ、皆のもの！ このベラートが出るぞぉぉぉッ！！:
Now that's the spirit!
Come on, everyone! It's time for this Belart to show you what he's made of!
m500527.だから自己顕示欲ぅ！！: That's what I mean about the ego trip!!
m500527.ちなみに同じ名前の建築物が、\nこの他にもざっと十数個存在しますわ。: By the way, there are roughly a dozen or so other structures with the same name.
m500527.ふふ、どう転んでも帝国の国威発揚になるのだから、\n気軽に全力でぼっこぼこにして:
Heh. No matter how it turns out, it serves to promote the empire's prestige.
So go ahead and beat them to a pulp without holding back.
m500527.ふむふむ、つまりこの要塞が、\nベラート伯爵――元伯爵の最高傑作だということね。: I see. So this fortress is the magnum opus of the Count of Belart—well, the former Count.
m500527.べらどんなさまー！\nてーこく軍にまけるなー！:
Lady Belladonna!
Don't lose to the Imperial Army!
m500527.イルヴィ、次に帝国とやり合うときには参考にしようぞ。: Irvit, let's keep that in mind for when we face the empire next time.
m500527.ベラドンナ、そんな情けない顔は見せないように。\n領民はあなたを信じてついてくる:
Belladonna, don't look so dejected.
The people are following you because they trust you.
m500527.一度は剣を向けあった仲だが、\nこれより先は、共に戦う仲間となる者たちだ。:
We may have drawn our swords against each other,
but from now on, you are comrades who will fight together.
m500527.勝たなくてもよろしいんですの？: So it's okay if we don't win?
m500527.勝敗ではなく、良い戦いをすることを心がけるのだ。: Focus on fighting a good battle, not just on winning.
m500527.否、これはいわばひとつの通過儀礼。\nベラドンナよ、お前が領主となるための儀式な:
No. This is, in a sense, a rite of passage.
Belladonna, it is the ritual for you to become the lord.
m500527.外部からむしり取り、自領の民に建築という仕事を斡旋し、\n経済を回しながら己の身:
Siphoning resources from outside, providing construction jobs to his own people,
keeping the economy moving while building a fortress to protect himself.
m500527.帝国軍なんざやっちまえー！\nベラート様！ 祝勝会はうちの酒場で頼みますぞー！:
Take down that Imperial Army—!
Lord Belart! We're holding the victory party at my tavern, so don't you dare miss it—!
m500527.我が伯爵領では、その代の最も偉大な建築や発明に、\n当主の名を冠するのが伝統にな: In our county, it is tradition to name the greatest architectural or technological achievements of an era after the lord in charge.
m500527.我が伯爵領の誇る最強の盾、\nベラート要塞が如何に堅牢であるか、\n皆さまにお披:
I'll show you just how impenetrable Belart Fortress is,
the strongest shield our county has to offer!
m500527.承知しましたわ父様！\nこのベラドンナ、最高の戦いをやり遂げますわよ！:
Understood, Father!
This Belladonna will deliver the finest battle of her life!
m500527.要塞に自分の名前を付けるとは、\nなんという自己顕示欲……。:
To name a fortress after yourself…
What an ego trip.
m500527.金が！ 利権が！ 向こうからやってくるのだ！: Money! Profits! They'll come running to us!
m500527.（アンジェリーネ様、\nやけにベラドンナさんのこと気にかけてますね）:
(Lady Angeline,
you seem unusually concerned about Miss Belladonna.)
m500527.（現状、伯爵領は厳しい立ち位置にあるのです。\n他の貴族が下手に手出しできないよ:
(As things stand, the Count's territory is in a delicate position.
By showing that she is Lady Angeline's favorite,
she ensures that other nobles won't dare interfere.)

m900380.――あれ？\nなんだか玉兎さんの雰囲気が変わりました？:
――Huh?
The Jade Rabbit's atmosphere seems to have changed?
m900380.――うさぎさんの神獣、ですか？: ――A divine beast that's a rabbit, you say?
m900380.――おやおや、満足そうな顔しちゃって。\nよっぽど戦う相手が来たことが嬉しかった:
――Oh my, oh my. You look quite pleased with yourself.
I suppose you were thrilled to finally find a worthy opponent.
m900380.――失礼します。\n今、お時間よろしいでしょうか？: ――Pardon me. Do you have a moment?
m900380.――強者と戦いたい。\nそれも可能なら、できるだけ多くの。\n……ふふっ、まぁそ:
――It wants to fight the strong.
And as many of them as it can.
……Heh, I suppose that's how it is.
m900380.――神獣玉兎。\nうさぎっていうから、\nシュシュみたいな可愛い子を想像してたけ:
――The Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit.
Since it's a rabbit, I imagined a cute girl like Shushu, but……
m900380.…………ご主人様、その、後ほどサイズ直しの時間を\nいただいてもよろしいでしょう: …………My lord, would it be alright if I took some time later to adjust the fit?
m900380.……あたしたちで、祝祭を受け継ぎましょう。\nさぁ王子ちゃん、神獣玉兎との奉納相:
……Let's carry on the festival tradition ourselves.
Come on, Prince! Let's give it our all
in the offering sumo against the Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit!
m900380.……あっ、それなら簡単な話じゃない？: ……Ah, then this is a simple matter, isn't it?
m900380.あっ……ちょっと待って。\n玉兎も神獣ってことは\n「神の威光」の力を持ってるん:
Ah…… wait a moment.
If the Jade Rabbit is a divine beast,
doesn't it possess the power of the "Divine Radiance"?
m900380.あっ、ここのサイズもおかしいかも！\nよーし、こんな感じかなー？ ぎゅーっ！:
Oh, the size here seems off too!
Alright, how about this? Squeeze!
m900380.あれ……？\nそれって、玉兎の着ていた衣装と同じもの？:
Huh……?
Isn't that the same outfit the Jade Rabbit was wearing?
m900380.いえ、メイドたるもの、\n公然の場でご主人様に抱きつくわけには――: No, a maid cannot simply embrace her master in public――
m900380.いつもは目覚めた時に、みんながお祭りしてくれたのに、\n今回はすっごく静かだから:
Usually, when it wakes up, everyone throws a festival for it.
But this time it's so quiet, so it must feel lonely!
m900380.うっわぁ！ すごい貫禄ですよー！: Whoa! It's got quite the presence!
m900380.うん、玉兎のお祭りの噂が、\n王国の方まで伝わってきたみたいでね。\n子供たちが: Yes, it seems the rumors of the Jade Rabbit Festival have reached all the way to the kingdom. The children were singing it♪
m900380.うーさぎーがいっぴき\nおっつきっさまー♪:
There's a bunny
coming to see you♪
m900380.えぇ、ご想像のとおりです。\n玉兎を倒しちゃうとですね、\n回復や強化をやめて、:
Yes, exactly as you imagine.
If the Jade Rabbit is defeated,
it stops healing and buffing, and sometimes turns violent……
m900380.えっ……神獣の衣装貰っちゃったんですか！？: Ehh…… you got the Divine Beast's outfit?
m900380.えっ、いやいや、強者と相撲を取りたいなら、\nさすがに遥か彼方に転移させるような:
Wh-What? If it wants to wrestle a strong opponent,
wouldn't it use a spell to teleport them far away, rather than……?
m900380.えっ、私に限って、サイズを間違えるはずが……。: What? It's impossible for me to get the size wrong……
m900380.おや、街の子供たちの遊び歌ですか？: Oh, is that a children's play song from the town?
m900380.この賑やかさも、玉兎の加護なのでしょうか……？\nともあれ、此度の神獣玉兎戦、お: Perhaps this liveliness is part of the Jade Rabbit's blessing……? In any case, well done on the Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit battle!
m900380.これが伝承にある、\n自分も戦いたくなっちゃったモードなんじゃない！？:
Isn't this the mode from the legends,
where it gets the urge to fight itself?!
m900380.さぁさぁ、さっそく着てみて！\n――はっ、王子、ここのサイズが甘いかもよ！:
Come on, come on, try it on right away!
――Huh, Prince, the size here might be a bit loose!
m900380.さすがにねー、鍛冶職人だけじゃどうにもならなくて。\nでもでも、きっと王子様に似: As expected, I couldn't manage it with just blacksmithing. But, but, it's sure to look great on the Prince, right?
m900380.しかし、ある時を境に\n神獣玉兎は長い眠りについてしまい、\n玉兎を讃えるお祭り:
But at some point, the divine beast fell into a long slumber,
and the festivals held in its honor gradually faded away……
m900380.しーっ！ セーラさん！\n今が王子に抱きつくチャンスだよ！:
Shh! Sarah!
This is your chance to hug the Prince!
m900380.じゃあさっそくお祭りですねー！\nわくわく、神獣玉兎さんのお祭り、\nきっとうさ:
Then let's get right to it with the festival!
I'm so excited! The Jade Rabbit's festival
will surely be a cute, bouncy, rabbit-filled affair――
m900380.そういうわけですから、ただのお祭りと油断せず、\n強力な神獣と戦う覚悟を決めて挑:
So, rather than treating this as a mere festival,
we must steel ourselves and prepare to battle a powerful divine beast!
m900380.そりゃまぁ、ドラゴンみたいに鱗があったり、\n獰猛な獣みたいに牙があったりするわ: Well, it's not like it has scales like a dragon or fangs like a ferocious beast……
m900380.それでは王子、\n神獣玉兎から授かった衣装に着替える時には、\n称号を「玉兎の祝: Then, Prince, when you change into the outfit bestowed by the Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit, please set your title to "One Blessed by the Jade Rabbit."
m900380.ただ、ずっと誰かを待っていて、\nでもその誰かが来てくれないというのは、\nただ:
I just think it's sad to wait for someone forever,
only for them never to come.
m900380.でも、どこか悲しそうな顔をしていますね……。\nやっぱり、誰も訪ねてこないのは、:
But it looks a little sad……
I suppose even a divine beast feels lonely
when no one comes to visit.
m900380.なるほど……祝祭の再現をしてあげれば、\n神獣玉兎を鎮められるかもしれませんね…:
I see…… If we recreate the festival,
we might be able to calm the divine beast……
m900380.はい、玉兎と呼ばれる神獣が目覚めたと報告が……。\nけれど暴れる様子もなく、\n:
Yes. We've received a report that the divine beast known as the Jade Rabbit has awakened.
However, it isn't rampaging.
Apparently, it's simply waiting for something on the stage.
m900380.ははぁん、わかったぞ。\n玉兎もだんだん楽しくなって、\n祭りに参戦したくなっち:
Hah, I get it.
The Jade Rabbit gets in the mood and
wants to join the festival, doesn't it?
m900380.ふっふー、神獣玉兎のお着物げっとー♪\nこれは複製品というか、人間用サイズかな？:
Hehe~! Got the Divine Beast Jade Rabbit's outfit~♪
It's more like a replica, or a human-sized version, I guess?
I can feel a ton of magic power in it~!
m900380.ほほう、これは……ふむふむ、ふふーん。: Oh my, this is…… hmm, hm hm, hehe~.
m900380.また目覚めた時は、ぜひとも相手をしてくれ、\nということではないかなーっと……。: I suppose it means, "Please come see me again when I wake up," or something along those lines…….
m900380.むしろその逆ですね……。\n祝祭を執り行う玉兎の神官は、同じ装いをするもの。\n:
It's actually the opposite…….
The priests who perform the Jade Rabbit's festival are required to wear the same attire.
In other words, it seems you've been appointed as the Jade Rabbit's priest, Your Highness.
m900380.よーし、ちょっと想像と違いましたけど、\n王子さま、神獣玉兎さんに挑みにいきまし:
Alright! It's a bit different from what I imagined,
but Prince, let's go challenge the Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit!
m900380.わ、わぁ……。\nえぇっとぉ、それならますます王国向けですね……。:
W, wow……
Well, that makes it even more suited to the kingdom, I suppose……
m900380.わわ、何かまずいことでも……？: W-wait, is something bad going to happen……?
m900380.んん……じゃあ、王国軍で\n玉兎のお祭りを開いてあげればいいってこと？:
Mm…… so, does that mean the Royal Army should
throw a festival for the Jade Rabbit?
m900380.んー、んっんー？\nあれぇ、使えそうな素材が落ちてないなー。:
Hmm, hmnnn?
Oh, there don't seem to be any usable materials dropped.
m900380.ミスリアさんから、\n新しい装束の手直しを依頼されたのです。: Mithria asked me to make some alterations to a new outfit.
m900380.今のは嫌味じゃないので、\nそんな顔しないでくださいねー。:
I wasn't being sarcastic, so
please don't look at me like that.
m900380.仲間が戦ってたら、\n自分も戦いたくなるのは戦士の常さ。:
When your comrades are fighting,
it's a warrior's nature to want to fight too.
m900380.伝承によれば、玉兎は仲間を癒やす術を持ち、\n同時にさらなる力を与える加護も備え:
Legend says the Jade Rabbit possesses the power to heal its allies,
and also a blessing that grants them even greater strength.
m900380.伝承によれば、玉兎は千年戦争を人類と共に戦い、\nその後は十二年に一度目覚め、\:
According to legend, the Jade Rabbit fought alongside humanity during the Millennium War.
After that, it would awaken once every twelve years
to bestow a blessing dance upon the surrounding villagers.
m900380.伝承によれば「神の威光」の力、\n玉兎も持っているようですね……。\nなので、複:
According to the legends, the "Divine Radiance"
seems to be within the Jade Rabbit's power as well……
So, it will likely be necessary to deploy multiple squads.
m900380.強力な障壁をまとっていますから、\n弱い攻撃では傷すら付けられないはずです。\n:
It is enveloped in a powerful barrier,
so weak attacks won't even scratch it.
Please focus all your firepower……!!
m900380.忘れられるって寂しいですものねー……。: Being forgotten must be so lonely……
m900380.怒ってる……いや、興奮してる？: Is it angry……? No, is it excited?
m900380.戦いが始まってから、しばらくは仲間と、\n強者たちの戦いを楽しんでいるそうなので:
Once the battle begins, it apparently enjoys watching
the fight between its allies and the strong contenders for a while……
m900380.残念むねんー。\nせっかく新装備を作ろうと思ったのに――あれっ？:
What a bummer~.
I was really hoping to craft some new gear, but—huh?
m900380.王子、神獣玉兎が仲間への支援をやめて、\nこっちに突っ込んできます！:
Prince! The Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit, has stopped supporting its allies
and is charging straight at us!
m900380.異国の装いなので少々苦労しましたが、\nご主人様にぴったりのサイズにできました。: It was a foreign style, so it was a bit of a challenge, but I've tailored it to fit you perfectly.
m900380.確かに！ いつもは皆でお祭りしてたのに、\n久々に目覚めてみたら誰もいないとか寂:
That's true! We always threw festivals together,
so if it wakes up after so long and finds no one there, it must be sad!
m900380.祝祭の伝統を忘れられてしまった、\n可哀想な神獣さま、か。\nせめて僕らで、奉納:
A pitiful divine beast,
whose festival tradition has been forgotten.
At the very least, let us be its opponent in the offering sumo.
m900380.神獣にまで好かれてしまうなんて、\n王子らしいというか、何というか……。:
To be favored by a Divine Beast……
That's very characteristic of you, Your Highness, I suppose…….
m900380.神獣玉兎の伝承どおりなら、\nこれから数年は豊作が約束されるはず。\n王国もます: According to the legends of the Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit, the next few years should be guaranteed bountiful harvests. The kingdom will surely prosper even more!
m900380.神獣玉兎は千年戦争を戦い抜いた強力な存在ですよ？\nそれゆえに、村一番の力自慢た:
The Jade Rabbit is a powerful being that fought through the Millennium War.
Therefore, the festival involves it testing its strength against
the strongest braggarts in the village.
m900380.神獣玉兎も、現代の子どもたちに\n物語が伝わって喜んでいるかもしれませんね。: Perhaps the Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit, is pleased that its story has been passed down to the children of this age.

m920038.……だがまぁ、人間が簡単に知れる真理など、\n本物の真理ではない。\n学者として: …But well, any truth that humans can easily grasp isn't the real truth. As a scholar, the pursuit never ends.
m920038.……所詮は人間。そろそろ限界が\n近づいているようだねぇ。: …After all, you're only human. Your limits are drawing near.
m920038.あなたは……。\nもしや報告にあったアルケミストですか？:
You are…?
Could you be the alchemist from the report?
m920038.あなたは……！\n彼女に何をしたんですか！: You…! What did you do to her!
m920038.いけ！ 魔物たちよ！\n賢者の石の力によって\n王子たちの防御力は低下している。:
Forward! Beasts!
By the power of the Philosopher's Stone, the princes' defenses are weakened.
m920038.いったい彼女は何なのでしょう。\nそれと先ほど話していた賢者の石……。\nとりあ:
What on earth is she?
And that Philosopher's Stone we were discussing…
We should probably follow her for now.
m920038.うふふ、やる気満々のようね。\nでも、いつも通りに戦えるとは限らないよ。\n魔女: Hehe, you look eager. But you can't count on fighting exactly as usual. You'll feel the power of a witch.
m920038.おっと。言い忘れていた。\n君たち脆弱な人間がワシに勝てる道理が\nないことを教: Oops. I forgot to mention—I need to teach you fragile humans that you have no chance of beating me.
m920038.ここからが面白い所だ。\nさぁ見せておくれ、強大なる力に弄ばれて\n苦悩する姿を:
Now the fun begins.
Come on, show me your suffering as you're toyed with by that overwhelming power.
m920038.この前はよくもやってくれたね！\n今回はもっとすごいの連れてきたよ。\nさあ、ぶ: Last time you really pulled it off! This time I've brought something even more impressive. Come on, let's feed you something huge!
m920038.この女を救いたいのかね？\n……そうだな。指定した場所でワシと戦え。\nこの前の: You want to save this woman, don't you? …Fine. Meet me at the appointed spot and fight me. I have to settle the humiliation from before.
m920038.この女神様の神殿がどうしても邪魔な\nようですね。\n絶対に守り抜きましょう。: It seems this goddess's temple is just in the way. We'll protect it at all costs.
m920038.この数の魔物を倒すなんて\n案外やるもんだ。\n英雄の子孫ってのもまんざらじゃな: Taking down this many monsters is surprisingly doable. Being a descendant of heroes isn't so bad after all.
m920038.この石さえあれば真理を……。: With this stone, I can see the truth…
m920038.これで魔物のシャドーを従えることができる……。\nふは……、ハハハ、ハハハハ……:
Now I can command the shadows of monsters…
Ha… Hahaha, hahahaha…
m920038.これ以上あの危険な石を使わせるわけには\nいきません。: We can't let her keep using that dangerous stone.
m920038.ご、ごせん……。\n相変わらず常識離れした攻撃力ですね……。\n上位のデーモンと: G-gosh… Your attack power is still absurdly out of common sense… No wonder you're a higher-ranking demon.
m920038.さぁ、賢者の石よ。\n再び我らにその力を貸すのだ……！:
Now, Philosopher's Stone.
Lend us your power once more…!
m920038.さあ、君たちを滅ぼすために\n最高の布陣を用意した。\n楽しもうじゃないか。: Come now, I've set the perfect formation to annihilate you. Let's have some fun.
m920038.そうだね。その石の力を使いこなせば\n君の望む真理を見ることができるさ。: Indeed. Master its power and you'll witness the truth you seek.
m920038.だが、王子よ。お前の存在が邪魔だ。\n私の願いのためにも、倒させていただく。:
But, Prince, your very existence stands in my way.
For the sake of my wish, I shall defeat you.
m920038.だが「あのお方」に譲り受けたこの力……。\n素晴らしい……。\nこれさえあれば真:
But this power I inherited from “that one”…
Magnificent…
With this, the day I see the truth draws near…
m920038.だがまぁ、面白い物も見れたし、\n賢者の石を媒体に地上に降りることが\nできただ: Still, it was entertaining, and just being able to descend to the surface using the stone is enough for me.
m920038.どうやら本来の彼女に戻ったようです。\n安心しました……。: It seems she's returned to her original self. I'm relieved…
m920038.どうやら私の手には負えないみたいだね。\nならば、あのお方に直接戦ってもらおうか: Looks like it's beyond my ability now. Then I'll have that one fight for me… Come on, chase them!
m920038.なぜ王国を実験場にしようと……？: Why would you turn the kingdom into a testing ground…?
m920038.ふぅ……。やはり人間ごときが扱えるシロモノでは\nなかったか。残念なことだ……。: Huh… So a mere human can't handle such a thing after all. What a disappointment…
m920038.ふふふ、しつこい奴らだね。\nもしかして私が欲しいのかい……\n私に勝てたら考え:
Heh, they're so persistent.
You want me, don't you…?
If you can beat me, I'll consider it.
m920038.ふむ……。もう会話もできないか。\n自我を失いかけてるみたいだね。:
Hmm… You can barely speak now.
Looks like you're losing your sense of self.
m920038.また防御力を……！\n王子、お気を付けください！:
Our defenses are dropping again…!
Prince, be careful!
m920038.もう完全に意識を奪われて……。\n王子、彼女を救うには賢者の石を\n断つしか方法: She's completely lost consciousness now… Prince, the only way to save her seems to be to sever the Philosopher's Stone.
m920038.ん～？ 真理を知りたいというその願いを\n叶えてやったまでだよ。: Huh? I merely granted her wish to know the truth.
m920038.ククク……。さすがは私だ……。\nこれなら人間を操ることができる……。: Heh heh… As expected of me… With this, I can control humans…
m920038.クククク……分かったぞ……。\n賢者の石の更なる力を発揮する方法が……！:
Hehehe… I understand now…
The method to unleash even greater power of the Stone…!
m920038.コリンさん、どうかお止めください！\nこれ以上はあなたにも何が起こるか……！: Corin, please stop! If you keep going, something will happen to you too…!
m920038.コリンよ。賢者の石を上手く\n使いこなせているようだね。: Corin. It seems you're handling the Philosopher's Stone quite well.
m920038.チッ……。\nそう簡単にはいかないか。:
Tch…
It won't be that easy.
m920038.ワシの攻撃力は5000だ。\nどうだ、絶望しただろう？。\nさぁ一人ずつ粉砕して: My attack power is 5,000. How's that, feeling despair yet? I'll crush you one by one.
m920038.君たちと戦うことをずっと楽しみにしていた。\n最高の戦場を用意してまっている。: I've been looking forward to battling you. I've prepared the ultimate battlefield.
m920038.彼女は今なにが見えているんだろうねぇ。\n真理、それともただの夢かな。\n興味深: I wonder what she sees now… Truth? Or just a dream? Fascinating…
m920038.彼女を解き放つためにも応戦しましょう……！: Let's fight back to free her!
m920038.心ここにあらずと言った感じですね……。\nひとまず王城に……。: She's… not really here, mentally. Let's get her back to the castle for now.
m920038.情けないものだな。\n真理を求めて事を起こしたのに……。\n賢者の石も、私の手に: Pathetic. I set out seeking truth, yet… the Philosopher's Stone didn't stay in my hands.
m920038.意識が賢者の石に持っていかれて……！\nしかし、まだ彼女を救う手立てはあるはずで: Her consciousness is being drawn into the Philosopher's Stone…! But there must still be a way to save her. Prince, let's follow her!
m920038.来たか。お前が王子だな。\n私はコリン……。\nそう、コリンだ。:
So you've arrived. You must be the Prince.
I am Corin… Yes, Corin.
m920038.森に住む者たちがこの周囲で\n逃げていく魔女を見たという話ですが…\nあの小屋が: The forest dwellers say they've seen the witch fleeing around here… Could that hut be her hideout?
m920038.気を付けてください。\nこの神殿を覆っている霧は\n癒しの力を妨げています。: Please be careful. The mist covering this temple hinders healing.
m920038.無駄だ。この女は完全に\nこちらの支配下にある。\n解放するにはワシらに勝つしか: Futile. She's completely under our control now. The only way to free her is to defeat us.
m920038.王子……王子……。\nあんたを倒セバ……真理を……。: Prince… Prince… If I defeat you… the truth…
m920038.王子、ここが正念場です。\nあのデーモンをたおすことができれば\nコリンさんを解: Prince, this is the critical moment. If we can take down that demon, we should be able to free Corin.
m920038.王子、どうやら報告にあったアルケミストが\nいるのはここのようです。: Prince, it seems the alchemist mentioned in the report is here.
m920038.王子、魔女はあの穴に逃げ込んだようです。\n何が潜んでいるかわかりません。\nお: Prince, the witch has fled into that hole. We don't know what's lurking there. Please be careful.
m920038.王子、魔物たちの襲撃です。\n女神様の神殿を狙っているようです。\n迎え撃ちまし: Prince, the monsters are attacking. They seem to be targeting the goddess's temple. Let's meet them head-on.
m920038.王子たちにも迷惑をかけた。すまないな。\n改めて、私はアルケミストのコリン。\n: I caused trouble for you princes as well. I'm sorry. Let me reintroduce myself: I'm Corin the Alchemist. If we meet again, remember me.
m920038.王子の兵士すら……、\n我ら、の……操り人形だ……。: Even the Prince's soldiers… are… our puppets…
m920038.真理を見たい……。\nそのためなら私はどうなっても……。:
I want to see the truth…
For that, I'll become anything…
m920038.真理を見たい……。\n真理……真理を……。:
I want to see the truth…
Truth… truth…
m920038.私は錬金術によって、この世の真理を見たい。\nそのためにはこの賢者の石を使い\n:
Through alchemy I seek to glimpse the truth of this world.
To that end I must use the Philosopher's Stone and make this country my laboratory.
m920038.賢者の石……！？\nもし彼女の言葉通りだとしたら\n王子、ここは慎重に行きましょ:
The Philosopher's Stone…!?
If her words are true, Prince, we must proceed with caution!
m920038.賢者の石によって、自我が失われていく様は\nじつに滑稽だったねぇ……。: Watching her lose herself to the stone was truly comical…
m920038.賢者の石を……最大限にィ……。\nこれで王子の防御力も……キャハハ……。\n紙切: I'll push the Philosopher's Stone to its limits… With this, the Prince's defenses will crumble… Hahaha… Like tearing paper…

m920046.あたしだってそうですよ！ 特訓で\n遠くの敵を狙えるようになったんです！: Same for me! The training let me target distant enemies!
m920046.ここまでくるなんてすごいじゃない。\n私が「拡散弾」を扱えるようになったのも\n: It's amazing you've made it this far. I was able to handle "scatter shots" thanks to the special training. Keep it up.
m920046.こちらでは、隊列を組んで進軍して頂きます。\n統率された行動を取るための演習です:
Here you'll march in formation.
It's an exercise in coordinated action.
m920046.この演習場は砂漠地帯となります。\n砂漠では出撃の際に体力が減少します。\nこの: This training ground is a desert area. In the desert, your stamina will decrease when you deploy. Remember that trait well.
m920046.さっきは助かったわ。迷惑かけて悪かったわね。\n私はカノン。あの場所で砲術士を目: Thanks for saving me earlier. Sorry for the trouble. I'm Kanon. I was training on my own at that place, aiming to become an artillery specialist.
m920046.せっかくですからお二人も特訓に\n参加されてはいかがですか？: Since you're here, why don't you both join the special training?
m920046.その方が、一人のときよりも楽しく\n学ぶことが出来るでしょう。: That way, it'll be more fun than training alone, and you'll learn more.
m920046.それでは、演習場に参りましょう。: Then, let's head to the training grounds.
m920046.それに、やっぱり仲間と一緒だと\n心強いわね。: And, of course, it's reassuring to have comrades by your side.
m920046.だからお願い。\nどうか私の訓練を手伝ってもらえないかしら。王子。: So please. Could you help me with my training, Prince?
m920046.どうやらここが魔物が出現した場所の\nようですが……。: It seems this is where the monsters emerged….
m920046.なんとか収まりましたね。\nひとまず戻りましょうか。:
Looks like it settled down.
Let's head back for now.
m920046.まずはここでの訓練から始めましょう。\nこの一帯は王城にほど近い田園地帯です。:
First, let's start training here.
This area is a rural region close to the royal capital.
m920046.よし！ なんとか倒せたわ。: Alright! We managed to take it down.
m920046.わかった！ やってみるわ！\n特訓、よろしくお願いします！:
Got it! I'll give it a try!
Looking forward to the special training!
m920046.カノンさんは、敵の移動速度を下げる\n砲弾をお持ちのようですね。\n使ってみるの:
Kanon, you seem to have shells that can slow enemy movement.
It might be worth trying them out.
m920046.今回は、機動力が大幅にアップする坂道の\n地形を活かす演習を行います。: This time we'll practice using the sloped terrain that greatly boosts mobility.
m920046.以前はちゃんとした砲術士の学校に通っていたんだけど、\n魔物が現れて学校は破壊さ: I used to attend a proper artillery school, but monsters appeared and the school was destroyed…
m920046.元士官学校のみんなも一緒なんだから\n絶対に負けたくない。\n特訓の成果を出し切: Everyone from the former officer school is here too, so I absolutely won't lose. I'll give it my all!
m920046.弱いから大事なものを守れなかった。\nもうあんな後悔はしたくない。\n自分のせい: We were weak and couldn't protect what mattered. I don't want to feel that regret again. I won't stand by and watch someone die because of me!
m920046.彼女は……？\nあの、どうかされましたか！？:
Who is she…?
Um, are you alright!?
m920046.授業で習ったことがある。たしかこの地形は\n攻める側にとって有利なのよね。\n実:
I learned this in class. This kind of terrain definitely favors the attacker.
It's a chance to test it in a real fight.
m920046.攻撃のタイミングをあわせることにも繋がるので\nとても大事ですよ。: It's crucial, since it helps us synchronize our attack timing—very important.
m920046.次からは、王子軍がお相手させていただきます。\nカノンさん側にも、王子軍から生え:
From now on, the Prince's forces will take over.
We've also prepared fresh soldiers from the Prince's army for your side, Kanon.
m920046.王子、このままでは彼女も危ないです。\n魔物を倒しつつ、彼女の動きを止めましょう: Prince, if we don't act, she'll be in danger too. Let's defeat the monsters and halt her cannon!
m920046.私だって少しは上達したはず……。\nやってやるわ！: I've improved a bit too... I'll show them!
m920046.私の持ってる大砲が暴走しちゃって……っ！\n暴発を止めてほしいの……！: My cannon went berserk…! I need someone to stop the misfire…!
m920046.隊列を組んで迎え撃つのも\n砲兵における戦術の一つって\n先生が言ってた気がする: I think the teacher mentioned that forming a line to meet the enemy is also a tactic for artillery.
m920046.魔物が現れたときに私たちをかばって助けてくれた先生や\n先輩たちの背中。仲間と森: When the monsters showed up, the teachers and seniors who protected us… We fled into the forest with our comrades and shivered for three days and nights…

m920071.――うッ、くぅぅッ……！\nまた、やられちゃうなんて……くやしいよぉー！: —Ugh, ugh…! To be taken down again… so frustrating!
m920071.――ぐァッ……はぁ、はぁ……。\nこ、これでも勝てぬとは……王子め……。\nその: —Gah… huff, huff… Even now I can't win… Prince… That spirit of yours… you truly are a hero…
m920071.――カッカッカ……妖虎仙よ。\nしつけを誤ったのぅ。\n虎姫めが全てをばらしてし: —Kakkakka… Youkosen. You've been mis-trained. The Tiger Princess has spilled everything…
m920071.――グルルル……。\n街へは向かわせん。\nこれ以上、妖虎仙様の邪魔はさせぬぞ！: ――Grrr… I won't let you head to the town. I won't let you hinder Lord Yōko any longer!
m920071.――何をきょろきょろしておる人間ども。\nわしを探しておるのかな？: —What are you humans staring at? Looking for me, perhaps?
m920071.…………ま、まさか、\n私達が街に来る前に出会っていた\nあのお爺さんが邪仙郷の: …I can't believe… that the old man we met before coming to town was actually one of the Jasenkyō….
m920071.……あ、ありがとう。\nメイリンなんかの為に……駆けつけてくれて。\n本当に、あ: …Th-thank you. Thank you for rushing here for someone like me. Really, thank you….
m920071.……あ、それで、\nメイリンからのお願いなんだけど……。\nこれからも、ここにい: …Right, there's something I want to ask… I'd like to stay here from now on…
m920071.……うぉぉぉおおおッ！！！\nこれだ、これこそが魔神ウェパルの力だ……。\n貴様: …Whoa!!! This is it, the true power of Wepal… Can you feel it, this terrible power!
m920071.……うん。もう大丈夫。\nちゃんと落ち着いたし、自己紹介できるよ。\n王子、わた: …Yeah. I'm fine now. I've calmed down and can introduce myself properly. Prince, my name's Meiling!
m920071.……え！ いいの！？\nわーい！！ ありがとう！ 王子！\nメイリン、精一杯頑張: …What! It's okay!? Yay!! Thank you, Prince! I'll do my best!
m920071.……おい、あの女の子を\nこのまま行かせていいのか？ \nもしかしたら操られてる: …Hey, should we just let that girl go? She might be being controlled…
m920071.……ぐ、うぅ……し、屍解仙め……。\nこれが貴様の……邪仙郷の奴らのねらい、か…: …Guh, ugh… You… Shikai-sen… Is this… the goal of those from Jasenkyō…? Meiling… run… you… only…
m920071.……ちィッ！？ なかなかどうしてやりよるわい。\n虎姫め、新しいキョンシーの製作: …What the—!? You're putting up quite a fight. Tiger Princess, you would have made perfect material for a new Jiangshi…
m920071.……どうやらメイリンさんも一緒のようですね。\n王子、妖虎仙の居場所までもう少し: …Looks like Meiling's with us too. Prince, we're almost at Youkosen's location! Let's win this battle no matter what!
m920071.……ま、待ってよ！\n父様にはもう戦う力なんて無いんだ……。\nお願いだから命ま: …Wait! Father has no strength left to fight… Please, don't take his life!
m920071.……まさかこれほどまでの\n力を持っているとは。\nどうやら目算を誤まっていたよ: …I never imagined you possessed such power. It seems we miscalculated…
m920071.……む？\n向こうから何者かがやってくるようじゃのぉ。\n……なるほど人間か。こ: …Hmm? Looks like someone's coming from over there. …Ah, humans. This is just the right opportunity.
m920071.……よかろう。\nだが、次は無いぞ……。\nメイリンよ、早う立て。退くぞ。: …Very well. But there will be no next time… Meiling, rise at once. Withdraw.
m920071.……んふぉぉぉおおおっ！ 感じますッ！\nあらゆるものを蝕もうとする恐ろしい力が: …Nn-ooo! I feel it! A terrifying power that devours everything!
m920071.……キョンシーとは、死んだ人間を\n妖術によって使役しているものです……。\n死:
…Jiangshi are the dead, controlled by sorcery…
It's a forbidden external art that toys with the souls of the dead!
m920071.……何か対策が必要かも知れませんね。\n王子をお護りする為にも、引き続き\n妖怪: …We may need a countermeasure. To protect the Prince, let's keep a close eye on the youkai's activities.
m920071.……機、いよいよ熟せり……。\n我が妖術の奥義……使うは今ぞッ！\nはぁぁぁアア: …Now, at last… the ultimate of my demonic arts… now is the time! Haaaa Aaaahhh――!
m920071.……王子がメイリンの父様を\nイジメルのがいけないんだ！: …It's wrong for the Prince to bully my father!
m920071.……色々と話を聞きたかったのですが、\nまた逃げられてしまいましたね。: …I wanted to ask you a lot of things, but you ran off again.
m920071.「アンデッド」という事ですね……。\n死者を弄ぶとは……なんて、ひどいことを……:
So they're “undead”… To toy with the dead… How horrible…
Is there no way to save them?
m920071.あ、あれは！？\n妖虎と一緒にいた女の子……！: Ah, what's that!? A girl with the Yōko…!
m920071.ああ、しかとこの目でな。\n……なるほど、どうやら本当に\n妖虎仙を追う者たちと: ???: Ah, with my own eyes. …I see, so you truly are the ones hunting Youkosen.
m920071.ああ、そうだ。\n其方の父君の名誉のためにも、\nここで王子たちを倒すのだ！: Yes, exactly. For your father's honor, we'll take down the Prince here!
m920071.あなたはいったい……。\nいえ、それよりも妖虎仙を見かけたのですか？: Who are you…? No, more importantly, did you see Youkosen?
m920071.あの道の先に妖虎仙に滅ぼされた街がある。\nそこが妖虎仙の領地となっているのじゃ: ???: Beyond that road lies the town destroyed by Youkosen. That's his domain… If you go, be careful.
m920071.あれが父様を苦しめてる悪い奴か……。\n王子を倒せば、父様がアイツらから\n悪口: So those are the ones tormenting my father… If we defeat the Prince, my dad won't have to endure their insults, right?
m920071.い、痛い！！\n手を放して！\nもうメイリンは邪仙郷の人達と関わりたくないの！: It hurts!! Let go of me! I don't want anything to do with the people of Jasenkyō anymore!
m920071.いえ、そんなことよりも気をつけてください！\nキョンシーは一筋縄ではいかない魔物:
No, more importantly, be careful!
Jiangshi aren't monsters you can deal with easily!
m920071.いえいえ！ メイリンさんは大事な仲間ですから。\nさぁ、皆さんそれでは帰還しまし: No, no! Meiling is an important comrade. Now, everyone, let's return. Thank you all for your hard work in this battle.
m920071.いつも素っ気なかったけど、\nちゃんとメイリンの事を想ってくれてたんだって分かっ: He was always distant, but I realized he really cared about me, and just the memories of him are enough for me to keep living!
m920071.うるさい、うるさい、うるさーいっ！\n絶対に王子を倒してみせるからな！\n首を洗: Shut up, shut up, shut—! I'll definitely defeat the Prince! Just wait for his head to roll!
m920071.お、お前は……妖怪総大将ぬらりひょん！？\nなぜこんなところに……！: Y-you're… the Grand General of youkai, Nurarihyon!? Why are you here…!
m920071.おい、また逃げるのか、屍解仙！？\n最後まで戦えってんだ！\n……くそ、見失っち: Hey, running away again, Shikai-sen!? Fight till the end! …Damn, I've lost sight of you.
m920071.おおおっ！？\nで……やはり、拙者らも飲むのですか？: Whoa!? So… we're supposed to drink it too?
m920071.おんのれぇ……っ。貴様らぁ！\nわしの苦労を水の泡にしよって……。\nいつか必ず: Damn… you! Throwing my hard work away… I'll make you see something someday!
m920071.お爺さん、これより私達は街に向かいます。\n帰途に不安があれば、\n護衛をつけま:
Grandpa, from here we'll head to the town.
If you're uneasy on the way back, we can assign a guard—what do you think?
m920071.ここは一度退くぞ、虎姫！: Let's retreat for now, Tiger Princess.
m920071.ここは一旦退くしかあるまい……さらばじゃ。: I guess I'll have to retreat for now… Farewell.
m920071.この区域で出現報告のあった魔物も\n何とか討伐できたようですね。\nそれでは王子: It seems we've dealt with the monsters reported in this area. Then, Prince, let's return.
m920071.この街を滅ぼして己の領地とした\n妖虎仙の仕業とみて間違いないと思います。: I'm pretty sure this is the work of the demon-tiger spirit who destroyed the town and claimed it as his domain.
m920071.これで彼らの魂も、\n術者の妖術の拘束から解放されることでしょう。\n本当に、よ: Now their souls should be freed from the sorcerer's cursed magic. I'm really glad…
m920071.これは礼を失したのぅ……。\nなぁに、妖虎仙の力の強大さに感嘆したのじゃよ。\n: How rude of me… Well, I was merely awed by Youkosen's overwhelming power. …Now, look, Tiger Princess. It seems the Prince has finally arrived, hasn't he?
m920071.これを煎じて飲めば、\n魔神ウェパルの力が手にはいるのだ！: If we brew and drink this, we'll gain Wepal's power!
m920071.これ以上無闇に進んでも意味が\nありませんね……どうしたらいいのでしょうか。: There's no point in forging ahead blindly… What should we do?
m920071.ごめんなさい、父様……。\nでも王子を倒さないと、またアイツらに悪口を\n言われ: I'm sorry, Father… But if we don't defeat the Prince, they'll keep bad-mouthing us and it'll be miserable, right? So…
m920071.さっきよりもいっぱい妖虎たちを\n連れてきたんだから、もう負けないぞぉ！！: I've brought even more Yōko this time, so I won't lose now!!
m920071.さっそく魔物が現れたようですね。\n王子、戦いの準備をお願いします！: Looks like the monster's already shown up. Prince, please prepare for battle!
m920071.さて、一先ずの膳立ては済んだようじゃな。\nこれで戦う意思に火がついたじゃろうて:
Well, the preparations are done for now.
That should have sparked your will to fight…
…I'm looking forward to see how it turns out.
m920071.さて、今日はお前を迎えにきたのじゃ、虎姫。\n仙人の才能のないお前でも役に立てる: Well then, I've come to fetch you today, Tiger Princess. Even someone without any immortal talent like you can be useful… Come this way!
m920071.し、信じられん……。\n新たに仲間にした妖怪たちが\n全員やられてしまうとは……: I… can't believe it… All the youkai I just recruited have been wiped out…!?
m920071.そ、そんなぁ……。\nいっぱい妖虎たちを連れてきたのに、\nまた負けちゃったよぉ: N-no… I brought so many Yōko, and we lost again…
m920071.そうですね……。\n王子、彼女たちを追いかけましょう！: That's true… Prince, let's chase after them!
m920071.そうは言うがな……ぬしも王子たちがすぐそこまで\n来ているのを感じ取っておるのじ: You say that, but you can feel the Prince is almost upon us, can't you? If you die before the chance matures, it'll be all for nothing.
m920071.それにしても、なんて酷い有り様でしょう。\n魔物がこんなに沢山……。\nあ、あそ:
But look at this terrible state.
So many monsters…
Ah, there seem to be people over there, Prince!
m920071.それにしても、まさか、\nぬしの最高の秘術でも敗れるとはのぅ。\nさて、この機を: Still, I never imagined even your ultimate technique could be defeated. At last, I've been waiting for this chance… Die!!
m920071.それに父様を殺せと命令したのは邪仙郷の奴らだし。\n次は王子を狙ってくると思う。: Besides, the ones from Jasenkyō ordered us to kill Father. They'll go after you next, Prince. When that happens, I want to help too.
m920071.それはこちらの台詞じゃ。\n急にいなくなったかと思えば、\nこのような愚かなこと: That's my line. You vanished suddenly, yet you were doing something so foolish…
m920071.それは私にも分かりませんが……。\nしかし、今は急ぎメイリンさんを追うしか\n方: I don't know either… But for now we have to chase after Meiling as fast as we can.
m920071.それは違うよ！\nキョンシーを操っているのは父様じゃない！\n街を襲ってボロボロ: That's not it! Father isn't the one controlling the Jiangshi! It was Shikai-sen who laid waste to the town!
m920071.ですが、妖術によって操られていたということは\n当然、術者がいるということですよ: But if they were controlled by sorcery, that means there must be a sorcerer, right? Who could have done such a terrible thing…?
m920071.でもいっぱい時間は稼げたみたいだし、\nこれなら父様も褒めてくれるはず……。\n: But it seems we bought a lot of time, so Father will be proud… I'm hurrying back to him!
m920071.ということは、まだ多くの人々が\n妖虎仙の妖術によって苦しめられている\n可能性: So there could still be many people suffering under that demon-tiger's sorcery…
m920071.どうやらここが先程の\nお爺さんが言っていた街のようですね。: It appears this is the town the old man mentioned earlier.
m920071.どうやら私達の追撃を退ける為の\n後陣のようですね。\n王子、戦いの準備をお願い:
It looks like a rear guard to stop our pursuit.
Prince, please prepare for battle!
m920071.どちらからも、凄まじい気迫を感じます……。\n王子、ここで全ての決着をつけましょ: I can feel an incredible aura from both sides… Prince, let's settle this once and for all here. Please prepare for battle!
m920071.どっかで野垂れ死んでおるかと、\n心配しておったが、元気そうで何よりじゃ！: I was worried you'd end up dying somewhere out there, but you look fine—good.
m920071.ならば、あちらの方角へ向かうといい。: ???: Then head toward that direction over there.
m920071.はぁ……はぁ……倒しても倒してもキリがない……。\nまさかこれ程の数のキョンシー:
Haa… haa… No matter how many we slay, it never ends…
I never imagined there'd be this many jiangshi…!
m920071.はい……。\n手下になりそうな妖怪を探していたようですし、\nより強大な力を手に: Yes… He was looking for youkai to make his subordinates and scheming to obtain even greater power.
m920071.ふふ、安心してくださいイロハさん。\n王子はこの通り無傷ですよ。\n……ですが、: Hehe, don't worry, Iroha. The Prince is completely unscathed. …But Nurarihyon's movements are concerning.
m920071.ふむ……良くやってくれたのう。\n最後の最後でわしに報いたな、メイリン。: Hmm… well done. At the very end you repaid me, Meiling.
m920071.ふむ。\n邪魔が入ってしもうたか……。\nまぁよい、まとめて相手にしてやろう。: Hmm. So interference has arrived… Very well, I'll deal with you all at once.
m920071.ほぉ……考えたのぅ妖虎仙。\nまさか世上の妖気を集約させ己が気とするとはな。\n: Hoo… you've thought this through, Youkosen. To gather all the world's demonic energy and make it your own, huh. Using a double-edged technique means you're desperate too.
m920071.ほぉ、おぬしらは随分と強いのじゃなぁ……。\nこれなら妖虎仙から街を救えるかもし: Ho, you're quite strong… With this, we might be able to save the town from Yōko-sen.
m920071.ま、待て屍解仙……！？ 逃げるなー！\nくそ……どこに消えたのよ……どこに……。: Wait, Shikai-sen…! Don't run—! Damn… where did he disappear to…? I'll… I'll definitely avenge Father!
m920071.む、無念……。\nつ、次こそは……必ずぅ……うぅぅ……。: Damn, how frustrating… Next time, I'll… definitely… ugh…
m920071.むしろ感謝してもらいたいくらいじゃのう。\nこれで、ぬしのような邪仙郷の異端児も: In fact, you should be grateful. Now even a heretic like you from Evil Immortal Village can earn some merit, right?
m920071.や、やられた～ッ！？\nあの、王子ってやつすっごく強いよぉ……。: I—I'm defeated! That Prince is unbelievably strong…
m920071.よ、妖虎仙様ッ！？ 虎姫様は貴方様のことを\n思って行動したのですぞ？ 少しは御: Y-Youkosen! The Tiger Princess acted thinking of you! Could you show a little mercy…?
m920071.よーしっ！ 任せておいて！\n虎姫メイリン、がんばるよっ！！\nみんなも父様の為: All right! Leave it to me! Tiger Princess Meiling will give it her all!! Everyone, lend your strength for my father, okay?
m920071.わかりました……。\nそれでは、私達はこれで。\nくれぐれも魔物には気をつけてく:
Understood…
Then, that's all from us.
Please be careful of the monsters.
m920071.わしがいつそのようなことをお前に頼んだ？\n……勝手なことをするようなら喰い殺す: When ever did I ask you to do such a thing? …If you keep acting on your own, I'll devour you.
m920071.わしは……機を待っているだけじゃ。\n王子達を打倒する為の機は、\n熟すまでにも: I'm just biding my time… The chance to bring down the Prince still needs a little more time to ripen.
m920071.わたしは小さい頃に父様……じゃなくて、\n妖虎仙に拾われて、\nそれから妖虎たち: When I was little, my father… no, Youkosen took me in, and I lived with the Youkosen.
m920071.カッカッカ……何を憤っておる妖虎仙。\nぬしから王子を倒そうという気概が感じられ: Kakkakaka… Why are you so angry, Youkosen? I sensed no resolve from you to defeat the Prince, so I lent you a Jiangshi.
m920071.カッカッカ……！\nこれで目の上のたんこぶだった妖虎仙も消えたし、\n邪仙郷の連: Kakkakka…! With the thorn in my eye, Youkosen, finally gone, I'll go report this good news to the Jasenkyō folk.
m920071.カッカッカッ。\nまさか、王子の元に身を寄せているとはのぅ、虎姫。: Kakkakka… So the Tiger Princess has taken shelter with the Prince, huh?
m920071.カッカッカッ！\nぬしの子の方がよっぽど勇ましいのぉ。\nいいじゃろう。わしのキ: Kakkakka! Your child is far more daring. Fine then, I'll send my Jiangshi after you.
m920071.キョンシー？\n見たことのない魔物ですね……。\nそれに人間の様にも見えるのです:
Jiangshi?
I've never seen such a monster before…
They even look human…
m920071.グルルル……。\nメイリンよ、やつらが王子軍だ。\nおぬしの力を存分に振るうがい: Grrr… Meiling, those are the Prince's troops. Unleash all your power.
m920071.ヒョッヒョッ……貴様らも運がないのぉ。\nわしの新たな仲間たちの\n腕試しによっ: Heh heh… You lot are unlucky. You'll lose your lives testing my new comrades!
m920071.ヒョッヒョッ。善哉善哉。\nこの地にこれほど多くの妖怪がいたとはのぉ。\nおかげ: Heh heh. How splendid. To think there were so many youkai here. Thanks to that, I've gained new followers.
m920071.メイリンさんが口にしていた、\n『時間を稼げた』とは\nどういうことなのでしょう: What did Meiling mean when she said she “bought time”?
m920071.メイリンは父様とずっと生きてきたから、\n少し変な所があるかもしれないけど、\n: I've lived with Father all my life, so I might be a little odd, but I think I can put his spear technique to some use for everyone.
m920071.事情はわかりませんが、まだ討伐すべき魔物は\n他の地にもいます。彼女を警戒しつつ: I don't know the details, but there are still monsters to hunt elsewhere. Stay on guard around her and let's continue the expedition as planned, Prince.
m920071.今は屍解仙を退けられただけでも良しとしましょう。\nそれよりもメイリンさんが無事: For now, just driving Shikai-sen off is enough. More importantly, Meiling is safe—that's what matters.
m920071.他国の妖怪どもが活気付いてるようじゃが、\nこれならば十全な備えとなろう……ヒョ: The other nations' youkai are getting lively, huh… This will make a perfect preparation… Heh heh. This will keep my reputation as the Grand General of youkai intact.
m920071.伝令！\n斥候部隊が敵影を確認しました！\nどうやら、妖虎のようです！: Messenger! Scouts have sighted enemy! Looks like a Yōko!
m920071.何か言ったか？\nまあいい、それではこちらも……ゴクリ、ゴクリ……。: Did you say something? Never mind, then we'll… *gulp gulp*
m920071.何やらお困りのようですなぁ……。\n妖虎仙がどうのと口にしていたようじゃが、もし: ???: You seem to be in trouble… You were muttering about Youkosen—are you chasing the Youkosen who just passed this way?
m920071.余計な気を回すな、メイリン！\n……くそ、あの愚か者めが……。\nもう行ってしま: Don't overthink it, Meiling! …Damn, that fool… Did he already leave…!
m920071.元々仙人になれる素質も力量もない奴だって、\n父様はよく言ってたんだ……。\nそ: He also often said I had no talent or ability to become a sage… I think Shikai-sen never liked my father either.
m920071.全てのキョンシーを鎮圧できたようですね！\n王子、お疲れ様でした。:
It looks like we've suppressed all the jiangshi!
Prince, good work.
m920071.分かっているではないか！\n話が早くて助かる……それでは共に\n大いなる力を手に: You get it, right? Short and sweet—thanks… Then let's both claim this great power!
m920071.勝手なことを……！ キョンシーを街に放ち、\n人々の安寧を踏みにじった妖虎仙を、: How dare you…! Unleashing Jiangshi on the town, trampling the people's peace—do you really think we'd forgive Youkosen for that!?
m920071.報告！\n前方にキョンシーを確認！ 警戒してください！: Report! We've spotted a Jiangshi ahead! Stay on guard!
m920071.大丈夫、メイリンは敵討ちなんて考えてないよ。\n父様は最後に、わたしだけでも逃げ: It's okay, I'm not after revenge. Father told me at the end to at least get me out and run away…
m920071.如何にも！\nこれこそは、魔神ウェパルの身体の一部……、\nわれらに偉大なる力を: Indeed! This is a fragment of the demon god Wepal's body… it will grant us tremendous power!
m920071.妖怪総大将を相手に\nこの程度で済んで良かった……。\n王子、お怪我はありません: Facing the Grand General and getting away with just this… Prince, are you unharmed?
m920071.妖虎仙が殺された今、メイリンさんを\nこのまま放っておくことはできませんね……。: Now that the Tiger Immortal is dead, we can't just leave Meiling like this… Let's protect her until she calms down.
m920071.妖虎仙が膝をついた……！？\n王子、トドメをさすのは今しかありません！: Youkosen has fallen to her knees…!? Prince, now is the only time to deliver the finishing blow!
m920071.妖虎仙の領地……。\n王子、急いでその街へ向かいましょう！: Youkosen's domain… Prince, let's hurry to that town!
m920071.屍解仙……なんで笑ってるのさ！？\n父様にとってこれは大事な戦いなんだよ！: Shikai-sen… why are you laughing!? This battle means everything to Father!
m920071.屍解仙……！\nなんでこんな所に……！: Shikai-sen…! How did you get here…!
m920071.屍解仙は、一度死ぬ事で肉体の老化を止めた後、\n「アンデッド」として蘇る事で、無: Father said that Shikai-sen stopped his body's aging by dying once, then revived as an “undead,” forcing himself into an immortal sage.
m920071.強大な力……！？\nということは手にされているソレは、もしや！？: Great power…!? That means the thing they're after—could it be…!?
m920071.待っておったぞ、王子。\n今日こそ貴様の命を貰い受けるとしよう。: I've been waiting for you, Prince. Today I shall finally claim your life.
m920071.待ってください！\nあなたは人間のようですが、\nなぜ妖虎と共に私達を襲うのです: Wait! You may look human, but why are you attacking us alongside the Yōko?
m920071.心配しないで、父様！\n時間ならメイリンが稼ぐからね！\nううん。いっそのこと王: Don't worry, Father! I'll buy us some time! No… actually, I'll just go and defeat the Prince for you!
m920071.応とも、虎姫！\n共に戦場を駆け抜けようぞ！: Indeed, Tiger Princess! Let's charge across the battlefield together!
m920071.我が領地にキョンシーを放っただと……？\n一体どういうつもりだ？\n答えよ、屍解: You released a Jiangshi into my domain…? What on earth are you thinking? Answer me, Shikai-sen!
m920071.方法は一つしかありません……。\nそれはキョンシーを無力化し、\n術から解放する:
There's only one way…
Neutralize the jiangshi and free them from the spell!
m920071.本当はイヤですが……ゴクリ、ゴクリ……。: Honestly, I don't want to… *gulp gulp*
m920071.父様、メイリンいっぱい頑張ったよ！\n王子を倒す為の準備の時間は\nちゃんと稼げ: Father, I gave it my all! We bought enough time to prepare to defeat the Prince, right?
m920071.父様が屍解仙に悪口を言われたのが許せなくって、\nつい、自分で王子を倒そうって思: I couldn't stand him insulting my father, so I thought I'd just defeat the Prince myself. I'm sorry…
m920071.父様と戦っても勝ち目がないからって、\nまさか、王子と戦わせるなんて……、\nほ: He claimed there was no chance of winning against my father, yet he makes me fight you, Prince… that's really cowardly.
m920071.父様の為にも絶対にここで\nメイリンが勝つんだから！\nさあ王子ッ、覚悟しろぉッ: For Father's sake, I'll win here! Come on, Prince—prepare yourself!!
m920071.父様は、邪仙郷っていう仙人の一勢力に\n属していたの。: My father belonged to a faction of immortals called the Evil Immortal Village.
m920071.父様をいじめる……？\n王子と貴方の父親とどんな関係が……？: Bully my father…? What's the connection between the Prince and your dad?
m920071.父様を殺した屍解仙もその一人だったんだけど、\n言うことをぜんぜん聞かない父様に: The Shikai-sen who killed my father was part of that group, but he kept nagging my father who never listened.
m920071.父様！ わたしも一緒に戦うからね！\nメイリンのほんとのほんとの本気を\n今こそ: Father! I'll fight alongside you! I'll show you my true, true, genuine resolve right now—!!
m920071.王子……敵だったメイリンを\n助けてくれてありがとね！: Prince… thank you for saving the enemy Meiling.
m920071.王子、お見事です。\n無事に敵を退けることができたようですね！:
Prince, splendid work.
It seems we've managed to drive the enemy away safely!
m920071.王子、このあたりで\n妖怪が出没しているとの噂ですが、\nどうにも見当たりません: Prince, there are rumors of youkai appearing around here, but I can't find any sign of them…
m920071.王子、これ以上\n妖虎仙を放っておいては危険です……。\n急ぎ街の奥へと進みまし: Prince, it's too dangerous to let that demon-tiger roam free any longer… Let's hurry deeper into the town!
m920071.王子、ご覧下さい！\n妖虎仙の姿があります！\nどうやらここが本拠地のようですね: Prince, look! There's Youkosen! It appears this is their stronghold…
m920071.王子、報告によれば、\nこのあたりで魔物の出現が確認されたとのことです。\n周囲: Prince, according to the report, monsters have been sighted around here. Let's investigate the area.
m920071.王子、妖怪たちが向かってきました……！\n急ぎ戦いの準備をお願い致します。: Prince, the youkai are heading our way…! Please hurry and prepare for battle.
m920071.王子、妖虎たちが一斉に襲いかかってきます！\n戦いの準備をお願いします！: Prince, the Yōko are charging all at once! Get ready for battle!
m920071.王子、戦闘のご準備を！\n屍解仙からメイリンさんを取り戻しましょう！: Prince, prepare for battle! Let's rescue Meiling from Shikai-sen!
m920071.王子、本当にありがとう。\n父様はいなくなっちゃったけど、\n王子のお陰で、こう: Prince, thank you so much. Father may be gone, but thanks to you, I've been able to recover my spirit!
m920071.申し訳ありません、王子。\n妖虎仙を追いかけていましたが、\nどうやら道に迷って: My apologies, Prince. I was pursuing Youkosen, but it seems I've lost my way.
m920071.皆の者、よく聞くのだ！\nついに我らは誰にも負けない\n強大な力を手に入れる日を: Everyone, listen up! At last, the day has come when we obtain a power that no one can defeat!
m920071.相も変わらず威勢だけは一人前じゃのぅ。\n……その気迫で今すぐにでも王子たちに\: Your bravado is as strong as ever. …With that spirit, you could just march straight at the Prince right now…
m920071.相当な妖術の使い手でなくては\nキョンシーを使役することはできません。: Only a truly skilled practitioner of dark arts could command jiangshi.
m920071.私ひとりではこれ以上戦えそうにありません……。\nどうか貴方の力をお貸し下さい！:
I can't keep fighting alone…
Please lend me your strength!
m920071.老い先の短い身ゆえ、\nそのような足労をかける意はどこにもありはせん。\nさ、気:
Being short on years, I have no intention of burdening you with such toil.
Now, go on without worry and walk the righteous path.
m920071.虎に似た魔物が出現したとのことですが……。: They say a tiger-like monster appeared...
m920071.行ってしまいましたね……。\nまるで、王子を仇のように言っていましたが、\n何か: She's gone… She spoke of the Prince as if he were a foe. Could she be misunderstanding something?
m920071.街にキョンシーを放ち、あまつさえ、\n仲間である妖虎仙まで殺すなんて……、\n信: He released Jiangshi on the town and even killed our ally, the Tiger Immortal… I can't believe it….
m920071.黙れ屍解仙！ \nそれ以上わしを侮辱するのならここで\n貴様の息の根を止めてやっ: Silence, Shikai-sen! If you keep insulting me, I might just end your life right here!
m920071.（それに、もし妖虎仙が王子を倒したとて、\n我が助力の果と報じ、己が功とすればい: Besides, even if Youkosen defeats the Prince, I can simply claim it as the result of my assistance and take the credit as my own. Of course, if we both fall, there's nothing to say…
m920071.（カッカッカ……それで良い、邪仙郷の異端、\n妖虎仙。貴様には随分と手を焼かされ: (Kakkakaka… that's fine, heretical Jasenkyō, Youkosen. You've given me a lot of trouble. For the sake of Jasenkyō, you should die here.)

m920084.――あぁッ！！\nセブンさんが逃げていきます！\nいつの間に縄を……。:
Ah—!!
Seven's running away!
When did she get tied up…?
m920084.――え？ やけに急かすな？ ……き、気のせいだろ！\nって、んなこと言ってる間に:
——Huh? Why are you hurrying me? …It's just my imagination!
And while I'm saying that, bounty hunters after the Prince are on their way, you know? Come on, hurry up!
m920084.――お、お前等は？！ ……こんな所に\nノコノコ現れるなんて、女神様がいようもの: —Y-you guys?! …Seeing a Nokonoko show up here, I'd be grateful if the goddess were here! You all, enemy attack!!!
m920084.――おい、あそこ見ろよ！ \n他に比べて敵の守りが薄い……。\nあれなら突破でき: Hey, look over there! The enemy's defenses are thinner there compared to the rest… We might be able to break through!
m920084.――おっと、こっちは行き止まりだぜ、嬢ちゃん！: —Whoa, this is a dead end, miss!
m920084.――おっ！？ ようやく王子ご一行の到着か。\nったく、待ちくたびれたぜぇ！:
—Whoa! Finally the Prince's party arrives.
Geez, I've been waiting forever!
m920084.――く、クソっ、なんてこった、金髪に貰った\n薬草は尽きた……旅の袋も空っぽ……: —Damn it, the herbs the blond gave are gone… our travel bags are empty… we're totally in the red! Time to retreat!
m920084.――ひぃ、ふぅ、みぃ……っと、へへ毎度あり♪\nまさかこんなに報酬をもらえるとは:
——Hii, fuu, mii… hehe, thanks as always♪
I never expected such a big reward.
Crossing that dangerous bridge to side with you, Prince, was finally worth it.
m920084.――シックス！ おい、聞いてんのかよ！\nどうしてナインを殺したんだ！\nアタシ:
Six! Hey, are you even listening?
